pred_sql: SELECT MAX("FREE MEAL COUNT (K-12)" / NULLIF("ENROLLMENT (K-12)", 0)) FROM california_schools.frpm WHERE "COUNTY NAME" = 'Alameda'

SELECT frpm."FREE MEAL COUNT (AGES 5-17)" / frpm."ENROLLMENT (AGES 5-17)" FROM california_schools.frpm frpm JOIN california_schools.schools schools ON frpm.cdscode = schools.cdscode WHERE schools.edopscode = 'CON' AND frpm."ENROLLMENT (AGES 5-17)" > 0 ORDER BY frpm."FREE MEAL COUNT (AGES 5-17)" / frpm."ENROLLMENT (AGES 5-17)" ASC FETCH FIRST 3 ROWS ONLY

SELECT DISTINCT T1.zip FROM california_schools.schools T1 INNER JOIN california_schools.frpm T2 ON T1.cdscode = T2.cdscode WHERE T2."CHARTER SCHOOL (Y/N)" = 1 AND T2."DISTRICT NAME" = 'Fresno County Office of Education'
SELECT s.mailstreet FROM california_schools.schools s JOIN california_schools.frpm f ON s.cdscode = f.cdscode ORDER BY f."FRPM COUNT (K-12)" DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY
SELECT s.phone FROM california_schools.schools s WHERE s.fundingtype = 'Directly funded' AND s.charter = 1 AND s.opendate > TO_DATE('2000-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD')
SELECT COUNT(T1.cdscode) FROM california_schools.schools T1 INNER JOIN california_schools.satscores T2 ON T1.cdscode = T2.cds WHERE T2.avgscrmath > 400 AND T1.virtual = 'F'
SELECT s.school FROM california_schools.schools s JOIN california_schools.satscores sat ON s.cdscode = sat.cds WHERE sat.numtsttakr > 500 AND s.magnet = 1
SELECT s.phone FROM california_schools.satscores ss JOIN california_schools.schools s ON ss.cds = s.cdscode ORDER BY ss.numge1500 DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY

SELECT SUM(T2.numtsttakr) FROM california_schools.frpm T1 INNER JOIN california_schools.satscores T2 ON T1.cdscode = T2.cds WHERE T1."FRPM COUNT (K-12)" = ( SELECT MAX("FRPM COUNT (K-12)") FROM california_schools.frpm )
SELECT COUNT(T1.cdscode) FROM california_schools.schools T1 INNER JOIN california_schools.satscores T2 ON T1.cdscode = T2.cds WHERE T2.avgscrmath > 560 AND T1.fundingtype = 'Directly funded'
SELECT f."FRPM COUNT (AGES 5-17)" FROM california_schools.frpm f JOIN california_schools.satscores s ON f.cdscode = s.cds ORDER BY s.avgscrread DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY
SELECT frpm.cdscode FROM california_schools.frpm frpm WHERE ( frpm."ENROLLMENT (K-12)" + frpm."ENROLLMENT (AGES 5-17)" ) > 500

SELECT MAX(f."FREE MEAL COUNT (AGES 5-17)" / f."ENROLLMENT (AGES 5-17)") FROM california_schools.satscores s JOIN california_schools.frpm f ON s.cds = f.cdscode WHERE s.NumTstTakr > 0 AND s.NumGE1500 / s.NumTstTakr > 0.3 AND f."ENROLLMENT (AGES 5-17)" > 0

WITH RankedSAT AS ( SELECT cds, (NumGE1500 / NumTstTakr) AS excellence_rate, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY (NumGE1500 / NumTstTakr) DESC) AS rn FROM california_schools.satscores WHERE NumTstTakr > 0 ) SELECT s.phone FROM california_schools.schools s JOIN RankedSAT rs ON s.cdscode = rs.cds WHERE rs.rn <= 3
SELECT s.ncesschool FROM california_schools.schools s JOIN california_schools.frpm f ON s.cdscode = f.cdscode ORDER BY f."ENROLLMENT (AGES 5-17)" DESC FETCH FIRST 5 ROWS ONLY

SELECT s.district FROM california_schools.schools s JOIN california_schools.satscores ss ON s.cdscode = ss.cds WHERE s.statustype = 'Active' GROUP BY s.district ORDER BY AVG(ss.avgscrread) DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.school) FROM california_schools.schools T1 INNER JOIN california_schools.satscores T2 ON T1.cdscode = T2.cds WHERE T1.county = 'Alameda' AND T1.statustype = 'Merged' AND T2.numtsttakr < 100

SELECT s.school, sa.avgscrwrite, s.charternum, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY sa.avgscrwrite DESC) AS writing_score_rank FROM california_schools.satscores sa JOIN california_schools.schools s ON sa.cds = s.cdscode WHERE sa.avgscrwrite > 499 AND s.charternum IS NOT NULL ORDER BY writing_score_rank

SELECT COUNT(T1.cdscode) FROM california_schools.schools T1 INNER JOIN california_schools.satscores T2 ON T1.cdscode = T2.cds WHERE T1.county = 'Fresno' AND T1.fundingtype = 'Directly funded' AND T2.numtsttakr <= 250
SELECT s.phone FROM california_schools.schools s JOIN california_schools.satscores sat ON s.cdscode = sat.cds WHERE sat.avgscrmath = ( SELECT MAX(avgscrmath) FROM california_schools.satscores )
SELECT COUNT(T1."SCHOOL NAME") FROM california_schools.frpm T1 WHERE T1."COUNTY NAME" = 'Amador' AND T1."LOW GRADE" = '9' AND T1."HIGH GRADE" = '12'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.cdscode) FROM california_schools.frpm T1 WHERE T1."COUNTY NAME" = 'Los Angeles' AND T1."FREE MEAL COUNT (K-12)" > 500 AND T1."FRPM COUNT (K-12)" < 700
SELECT sname, numtsttakr FROM california_schools.satscores WHERE cname = 'Contra Costa' ORDER BY numtsttakr DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY

SELECT s.school, s.street || ', ' || s.city || ', ' || s.state || ' ' || s.zip FROM california_schools.schools s JOIN california_schools.frpm f ON s.cdscode = f.cdscode WHERE f."ENROLLMENT (K-12)" - f."ENROLLMENT (AGES 5-17)" > 30

SELECT T1."SCHOOL NAME" FROM california_schools.frpm T1 INNER JOIN california_schools.satscores T2 ON T1.cdscode = T2.cds WHERE T1."ENROLLMENT (K-12)" > 0 AND T1."FREE MEAL COUNT (K-12)" / T1."ENROLLMENT (K-12)" > 0.1 AND T2.numge1500 > 0

WITH RiversideSchoolsWithSAT AS ( SELECT s.school, s.fundingtype, sat.avgscrmath FROM california_schools.schools s JOIN california_schools.satscores sat ON s.cdscode = sat.cds WHERE s.county = 'Riverside' ) SELECT rs.school, rs.fundingtype FROM RiversideSchoolsWithSAT rs WHERE (SELECT SUM(avgscrmath) / COUNT(school) FROM RiversideSchoolsWithSAT) > 400

SELECT s.school, s.mailstreet, s.mailcity, s.mailstate, s.mailzip FROM california_schools.schools s JOIN california_schools.frpm f ON s.cdscode = f.cdscode WHERE s.eilname = 'High School' AND s.county = 'MONTEREY' AND f."FRPM COUNT (AGES 5-17)" > 800

SELECT s.school, ss.avgscrwrite, s.phone FROM california_schools.schools s JOIN california_schools.satscores ss ON s.cdscode = ss.cds WHERE s.opendate > DATE '1991-12-31' OR s.closeddate < DATE '2000-01-01'

WITH LocallyFundedEnrollmentDiff AS ( SELECT f."SCHOOL NAME", f.cdscode, (f."ENROLLMENT (K-12)" - f."ENROLLMENT (AGES 5-17)") AS enrollment_difference FROM california_schools.frpm f WHERE f."CHARTER FUNDING TYPE" = 'Locally funded' ), AverageDifference AS ( SELECT AVG(enrollment_difference) AS avg_diff FROM LocallyFundedEnrollmentDiff ) SELECT lfe."SCHOOL NAME", s.doctype FROM LocallyFundedEnrollmentDiff lfe JOIN california_schools.schools s ON lfe.cdscode = s.cdscode CROSS JOIN AverageDifference ad WHERE lfe.enrollment_difference > ad.avg_diff
SELECT s.opendate FROM california_schools.frpm f JOIN california_schools.schools s ON f.cdscode = s.cdscode ORDER BY f."ENROLLMENT (K-12)" DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY
SELECT s.city FROM california_schools.frpm f JOIN california_schools.schools s ON f.cdscode = s.cdscode GROUP BY s.city ORDER BY SUM(f."ENROLLMENT (K-12)") ASC FETCH FIRST 5 ROWS ONLY

SELECT "SCHOOL NAME", "FREE MEAL COUNT (K-12)" / "ENROLLMENT (K-12)" AS eligible_free_rate FROM ( SELECT "SCHOOL NAME", "ENROLLMENT (K-12)", "FREE MEAL COUNT (K-12)", ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY "ENROLLMENT (K-12)" DESC ) AS rn FROM california_schools.frpm WHERE "ENROLLMENT (K-12)" IS NOT NULL AND "ENROLLMENT (K-12)" > 0 ) WHERE rn IN (10, 11)

SELECT CASE WHEN f."ENROLLMENT (K-12)" > 0 THEN f."FRPM COUNT (K-12)" / f."ENROLLMENT (K-12)" ELSE 0 END FROM california_schools.frpm f JOIN california_schools.schools s ON f.cdscode = s.cdscode WHERE s.soc = '66' ORDER BY f."FRPM COUNT (K-12)" DESC FETCH FIRST 5 ROWS ONLY
SELECT s.school, s.website FROM california_schools.schools s JOIN california_schools.frpm f ON s.cdscode = f.cdscode WHERE f."FREE MEAL COUNT (AGES 5-17)" BETWEEN 1900 AND 2000

SELECT CASE WHEN f."ENROLLMENT (AGES 5-17)" = 0 THEN NULL ELSE f."FREE MEAL COUNT (AGES 5-17)" / f."ENROLLMENT (AGES 5-17)" END FROM california_schools.schools s JOIN california_schools.frpm f ON s.cdscode = f.cdscode WHERE s.admfname1 = 'Kacey' AND s.admlname1 = 'Gibson'

SELECT s.AdmEmail1 FROM california_schools.frpm f JOIN california_schools.schools s ON f.cdscode = s.cdscode WHERE f."CHARTER SCHOOL (Y/N)" = 1 AND f."ENROLLMENT (K-12)" IS NOT NULL ORDER BY f."ENROLLMENT (K-12)" ASC FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY

SELECT CASE WHEN s.AdmFName1 IS NOT NULL AND s.AdmLName1 IS NOT NULL THEN s.AdmFName1 || ' ' || s.AdmLName1 END AS Administrator1, CASE WHEN s.AdmFName2 IS NOT NULL AND s.AdmLName2 IS NOT NULL THEN s.AdmFName2 || ' ' || s.AdmLName2 END AS Administrator2, CASE WHEN s.AdmFName3 IS NOT NULL AND s.AdmLName3 IS NOT NULL THEN s.AdmFName3 || ' ' || s.AdmLName3 END AS Administrator3 FROM california_schools.schools s JOIN california_schools.satscores sat ON s.cdscode = sat.cds ORDER BY sat.numge1500 DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY

WITH SchoolExcellence AS ( SELECT cds, (CAST(NumGE1500 AS NUMBER) / NumTstTakr) AS excellence_rate FROM california_schools.satscores WHERE NumTstTakr IS NOT NULL AND NumTstTakr > 0 ), MinExcellence AS ( SELECT MIN(excellence_rate) AS min_rate FROM SchoolExcellence ) SELECT s.street, s.city, s.zip, s.state FROM california_schools.schools s JOIN SchoolExcellence se ON s.cdscode = se.cds JOIN MinExcellence me ON se.excellence_rate = me.min_rate
SELECT T1.website FROM california_schools.schools T1 INNER JOIN california_schools.satscores T2 ON T1.cdscode = T2.cds WHERE T2.cname = 'Los Angeles' AND T2.numtsttakr BETWEEN 2000 AND 3000
SELECT AVG(T2.numtsttakr) FROM california_schools.schools T1 INNER JOIN california_schools.satscores T2 ON T1.cdscode = T2.cds WHERE T1.county = 'Fresno' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM T1.opendate) = 1980
SELECT s.phone FROM california_schools.satscores ss JOIN california_schools.schools s ON ss.cds = s.cdscode WHERE ss.dname = 'FRESNO UNIFIED' ORDER BY ss.avgscrread ASC FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY

WITH RankedSchools AS ( SELECT s.school, s.county, ss.avgscrread, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.county ORDER BY ss.avgscrread DESC) AS rn FROM california_schools.schools s JOIN california_schools.satscores ss ON s.cdscode = ss.cds WHERE s.virtual = 'F' ) SELECT school FROM RankedSchools WHERE rn <= 5
SELECT s.edopsname FROM california_schools.schools s JOIN california_schools.satscores sat ON s.cdscode = sat.cds WHERE sat.avgscrmath = ( SELECT MAX(avgscrmath) FROM california_schools.satscores )
SELECT s.avgscrmath, s.cname FROM california_schools.satscores s ORDER BY s.avgscrmath + s.avgscrread + s.avgscrwrite FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY

SELECT T1.avgscrwrite, T2.city FROM california_schools.satscores T1 JOIN california_schools.schools T2 ON T1.cds = T2.cdscode WHERE T1.numge1500 = ( SELECT MAX(numge1500) FROM california_schools.satscores )
SELECT s.school, sat.avgscrwrite FROM california_schools.schools s JOIN california_schools.satscores sat ON s.cdscode = sat.cds WHERE s.admfname1 = 'Ricci' AND s.admlname1 = 'Ulrich'

WITH RankedSchools AS ( SELECT s.school, f."ENROLLMENT (K-12)" AS enrollment_k12, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY f."ENROLLMENT (K-12)" DESC) as rnk FROM california_schools.schools s JOIN california_schools.frpm f ON s.cdscode = f.cdscode WHERE s.doc = '31' ) SELECT school, enrollment_k12 FROM RankedSchools WHERE rnk = 1
SELECT COUNT(T1.cdscode) / 12 FROM california_schools.schools T1 WHERE T1.county = 'Alameda' AND T1.doc = '52' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM T1.opendate) = 1980
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN s.county = 'Orange' AND s.doc = '54' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN s.doc = '52' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) FROM california_schools.schools s WHERE s.statustype = 'Merged'

WITH TopCounty AS ( SELECT county FROM california_schools.schools WHERE statustype = 'Closed' GROUP BY county ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY ) SELECT s.county, s.school, s.closeddate FROM california_schools.schools s JOIN TopCounty tc ON s.county = tc.county WHERE s.statustype = 'Closed'

WITH RankedSchools AS ( SELECT sname, avgscrmath, cds, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY avgscrmath DESC) AS rn FROM california_schools.satscores WHERE avgscrmath IS NOT NULL ) SELECT s.school, s.mailstreet, s.mailcity, s.mailstate, s.mailzip FROM california_schools.schools s JOIN RankedSchools rs ON s.cdscode = rs.cds WHERE rs.rn = 7

SELECT s.mailstreet, s.school FROM california_schools.satscores ss JOIN california_schools.schools s ON ss.cds = s.cdscode WHERE ss.avgscrread = ( SELECT MIN(avgscrread) FROM california_schools.satscores )

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.cdscode) FROM california_schools.schools T1 INNER JOIN california_schools.satscores T2 ON T1.cdscode = T2.cds WHERE T1.mailcity = 'Lakeport' AND ( T2.avgscrread + T2.avgscrmath + T2.avgscrwrite ) >= 1500
SELECT SUM(T2.numtsttakr) FROM california_schools.schools T1 INNER JOIN california_schools.satscores T2 ON T1.cdscode = T2.cds WHERE T1.mailcity = 'Fresno'
SELECT school, mailzip FROM california_schools.schools WHERE admfname1 = 'Avetik' AND admlname1 = 'Atoian'
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN s.county = 'COLUSA' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN s.county = 'HUMBOLDT' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) FROM california_schools.schools s WHERE s.mailstate = 'CA'
SELECT COUNT(T1.cdscode) FROM california_schools.schools T1 WHERE T1.mailstate = 'CA' AND T1.statustype = 'Active' AND T1.mailcity = 'San Joaquin'

WITH RankedSchools AS ( SELECT cds, sname, avgscrwrite, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY avgscrwrite DESC) AS rn FROM california_schools.satscores WHERE avgscrwrite IS NOT NULL ) SELECT s.phone, s.ext FROM california_schools.schools s JOIN RankedSchools rs ON s.cdscode = rs.cds WHERE rs.rn = 333
SELECT T1.phone, T1.ext, T1.school FROM california_schools.schools T1 WHERE T1.zip = '95203-3704'

SELECT T.website FROM california_schools.schools T WHERE ( (T.admfname1 = 'Mike' AND T.admlname1 = 'Larson') OR (T.admfname2 = 'Mike' AND T.admlname2 = 'Larson') OR (T.admfname3 = 'Mike' AND T.admlname3 = 'Larson') ) AND ( (T.admfname1 = 'Dante' AND T.admlname1 = 'Alvarez') OR (T.admfname2 = 'Dante' AND T.admlname2 = 'Alvarez') OR (T.admfname3 = 'Dante' AND T.admlname3 = 'Alvarez') )
SELECT T1.website FROM california_schools.schools T1 WHERE T1.virtual = 'P' AND T1.charter = 1 AND T1.county = 'San Joaquin'
SELECT COUNT(T1.school) FROM california_schools.schools T1 WHERE T1.charter = 1 AND T1.city = 'Hickman' AND T1.doc = '52'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.cdscode) FROM california_schools.schools s JOIN california_schools.frpm f ON s.cdscode = f.cdscode WHERE s.charter = 0 AND s.county = 'Los Angeles' AND f."ENROLLMENT (K-12)" IS NOT NULL AND f."FREE MEAL COUNT (K-12)" IS NOT NULL AND f."ENROLLMENT (K-12)" > 0 AND (f."FREE MEAL COUNT (K-12)" * 100 / f."ENROLLMENT (K-12)") < 0.18

SELECT s.school, s.city, s.admfname1 || ' ' || s.admlname1 AS administrator_1_full_name, s.admfname2 || ' ' || s.admlname2 AS administrator_2_full_name, s.admfname3 || ' ' || s.admlname3 AS administrator_3_full_name FROM california_schools.schools s WHERE s.charter = 1 AND s.charternum = '00D2'
SELECT COUNT(school) FROM california_schools.schools WHERE mailcity = 'Hickman' AND charternum = '00D4'
SELECT ( SUM(CASE WHEN s.fundingtype = 'Locally funded' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(s.cdscode) ) * 100 FROM california_schools.schools s WHERE s.county = 'Santa Clara' AND s.charter = 1

SELECT COUNT(schools.cdscode) FROM california_schools.schools schools WHERE schools.opendate >= TO_DATE('2000-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND schools.opendate <= TO_DATE('2005-12-31', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND schools.county = 'Stanislaus' AND schools.fundingtype = 'Directly funded'
SELECT COUNT(T1.cdscode) FROM california_schools.schools T1 WHERE T1.doctype = 'Community College District' AND T1.city = 'San Francisco' AND TO_CHAR(T1.closeddate, 'YYYY') = '1989'

SELECT s.county FROM california_schools.schools s WHERE s.SOC = '11' AND s.closeddate BETWEEN TO_DATE('1980-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND TO_DATE('1989-12-31', 'YYYY-MM-DD') GROUP BY s.county ORDER BY COUNT(s.cdscode) DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY
SELECT T1.ncesdist FROM california_schools.schools T1 WHERE T1.soc = '31'
SELECT COUNT(T1.cdscode) FROM california_schools.schools T1 WHERE T1.county = 'Alpine' AND T1.soctype = 'District Community Day School' AND T1.statustype IN ('Active', 'Closed')
SELECT T2."DISTRICT CODE" FROM california_schools.schools T1 INNER JOIN california_schools.frpm T2 ON T1.cdscode = T2.cdscode WHERE T1.city = 'Fresno' AND T1.magnet = 0

SELECT SUM(T1."ENROLLMENT (AGES 5-17)") FROM california_schools.frpm T1 INNER JOIN california_schools.schools T2 ON T1.cdscode = T2.cdscode WHERE T1."ACADEMIC YEAR" = '2014-2015' AND T2.city = 'Fremont' AND T2.edopscode = 'SSS'

SELECT T1."FRPM COUNT (AGES 5-17)" FROM california_schools.frpm T1 INNER JOIN california_schools.schools T2 ON T1.cdscode = T2.cdscode WHERE T2.edopsname = 'Youth Authority School' AND T2.mailstreet = 'PO Box 1040'
SELECT T1.gsoffered FROM california_schools.schools T1 WHERE T1.edopscode = 'SPECON' AND T1.ncesdist = '0613360'

SELECT s.eilname, s.school FROM california_schools.schools s JOIN california_schools.frpm f ON s.cdscode = f.cdscode WHERE f."NSLP PROVISION STATUS" = 'Breakfast Provision 2' AND f."COUNTY CODE" = '37'

SELECT T2.city FROM california_schools.frpm T1 INNER JOIN california_schools.schools T2 ON T1.cdscode = T2.cdscode WHERE T1."NSLP PROVISION STATUS" = 'Provision 2' AND T1."LOW GRADE" = '09' AND T1."HIGH GRADE" = '12' AND T1."COUNTY NAME" = 'Merced' AND T2.EILCode = 'HS'

SELECT T1."SCHOOL NAME", T1."PERCENT (%) ELIGIBLE FRPM (AGES 5-17)" FROM california_schools.frpm T1 INNER JOIN california_schools.schools T2 ON T1.cdscode = T2.cdscode WHERE T2.county = 'Los Angeles' AND T2.gsserved = 'K-9'
SELECT GSserved FROM california_schools.schools WHERE city = 'Adelanto' GROUP BY GSserved ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY

SELECT s.county, COUNT(s.cdscode) AS number_of_schools_without_physical_building FROM california_schools.schools s WHERE s.virtual = 'F' AND s.county IN ('San Diego', 'Santa Barbara') GROUP BY s.county ORDER BY number_of_schools_without_physical_building DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY
SELECT s.SOCType, s.school, s.latitude FROM california_schools.schools s ORDER BY s.latitude DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY

SELECT s.city, s.school, SUBSTR(s.gsoffered, 1, INSTR(s.gsoffered, '-') - 1) AS lowest_grade FROM california_schools.schools s WHERE s.state = 'CA' AND s.latitude = ( SELECT MIN(s2.latitude) FROM california_schools.schools s2 WHERE s2.state = 'CA' )
SELECT s.gsoffered FROM california_schools.schools s WHERE s.longitude = ( SELECT MAX(longitude) FROM california_schools.schools )

WITH MagnetK8MultiProvisionCount AS ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.cdscode) AS total_magnet_k8_multi_provision_schools FROM california_schools.schools s JOIN california_schools.frpm f ON s.cdscode = f.cdscode WHERE s.magnet = 1 AND s.gsserved = 'K-8' AND f."NSLP PROVISION STATUS" = 'Multiple Provision Types' ), K8SchoolsPerCity AS ( SELECT s.city, COUNT(DISTINCT s.cdscode) AS num_k8_schools_in_city FROM california_schools.schools s WHERE s.gsserved = 'K-8' GROUP BY s.city ) SELECT (SELECT total_magnet_k8_multi_provision_schools FROM MagnetK8MultiProvisionCount) AS total_magnet_k8_multi_provision_schools, kpc.city, kpc.num_k8_schools_in_city FROM K8SchoolsPerCity kpc ORDER BY kpc.city

WITH AdminNames AS ( SELECT TRIM(s.district) AS district, TRIM(s.admfname1) AS admin_fname FROM california_schools.schools s WHERE s.admfname1 IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(s.admfname1) IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT TRIM(s.district) AS district, TRIM(s.admfname2) AS admin_fname FROM california_schools.schools s WHERE s.admfname2 IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(s.admfname2) IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT TRIM(s.district) AS district, TRIM(s.admfname3) AS admin_fname FROM california_schools.schools s WHERE s.admfname3 IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(s.admfname3) IS NOT NULL ), RankedNames AS ( SELECT admin_fname, COUNT(*) AS name_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn FROM AdminNames GROUP BY admin_fname ) SELECT rn.admin_fname, LISTAGG(DISTINCT an.district, ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY an.district) AS districts FROM AdminNames an JOIN RankedNames rn ON an.admin_fname = rn.admin_fname WHERE rn.rn <= 2 GROUP BY rn.admin_fname, rn.name_count ORDER BY rn.name_count DESC
SELECT T1."PERCENT (%) ELIGIBLE FREE (K-12)", T1."DISTRICT CODE" FROM california_schools.frpm T1 INNER JOIN california_schools.schools T2 ON T1.cdscode = T2.cdscode WHERE T2.admfname1 = 'Alusine'
SELECT T1.AdmLName1, T1.district, T1.county, T1.school FROM california_schools.schools T1 WHERE T1.charternum = '40'

SELECT DISTINCT s.admemail1 FROM california_schools.schools s WHERE s.county = 'San Bernardino' AND s.city = 'San Bernardino' AND s.district = 'San Bernardino City Unified' AND s.opendate BETWEEN DATE '2009-01-01' AND DATE '2010-12-31' AND s.soc = '62' AND s.doc = '54' AND s.admemail1 IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(TRIM(s.admemail1)) > 0
SELECT s.school, s.AdmEmail1 FROM california_schools.schools s JOIN california_schools.satscores ss ON s.cdscode = ss.cds ORDER BY ss.numge1500 DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.account_id) FROM financial.trans T1 INNER JOIN financial.account T2 ON T1.account_id = T2.account_id INNER JOIN financial.district T3 ON T2.district_id = T3.district_id WHERE T1.operation = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU' AND T3.a3 = 'East Bohemia'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l.account_id) FROM financial.loan l JOIN financial.account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id JOIN financial.district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id WHERE d.a3 = 'Prague' AND l.status IN ('A', 'C')
SELECT CASE WHEN AVG(d.a12) > AVG(d.a13) THEN '1995 has higher average unemployment percentage' ELSE '1996 has higher average unemployment percentage' END FROM financial.district d
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.district_id) FROM financial.district d JOIN financial.client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id WHERE c.gender = 'F' AND d.a11 > 6000 AND d.a11 < 10000
SELECT COUNT(T1.client_id) FROM financial.client T1 INNER JOIN financial.district T2 ON T1.district_id = T2.district_id WHERE T1.gender = 'M' AND T2.a3 = 'North Bohemia' AND T2.a11 > 8000

SELECT COUNT(T1.account_id) FROM financial.account T1 INNER JOIN financial.district T2 ON T1.district_id = T2.district_id WHERE T2.a2 = 'Beroun' AND T1."DATE" > TO_DATE('19961231', 'YYYYMMDD')

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.client_id) FROM financial.client T1 INNER JOIN financial.disp T2 ON T1.client_id = T2.client_id INNER JOIN financial.card T3 ON T2.disp_id = T3.disp_id WHERE T1.gender = 'F' AND T3.type = 'junior'

SELECT ( COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN T3.gender = 'F' THEN T3.client_id ELSE NULL END) / COUNT(DISTINCT T3.client_id) ) * 100 FROM financial.district T1 INNER JOIN financial.account T2 ON T1.district_id = T2.district_id INNER JOIN financial.disp T4 ON T2.account_id = T4.account_id INNER JOIN financial.client T3 ON T4.client_id = T3.client_id WHERE T1.a3 = 'Prague'

WITH WeeklyStatementClients AS ( SELECT DISTINCT c.client_id, c.gender FROM financial.client c JOIN financial.disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id JOIN financial.account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE' ) SELECT (SUM(CASE WHEN wsc.gender = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0) / COUNT(wsc.client_id) FROM WeeklyStatementClients wsc

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.client_id) FROM financial.client T1 INNER JOIN financial.disp T2 ON T1.client_id = T2.client_id INNER JOIN financial.account T3 ON T2.account_id = T3.account_id WHERE T2.type = 'OWNER' AND T3.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'

WITH EligibleLoans AS ( SELECT l.account_id, l.amount FROM financial.loan l WHERE l.duration > 24 ), EligibleAccounts AS ( SELECT a.account_id FROM financial.account a WHERE a."DATE" < TO_DATE('1997-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') ), CombinedEligible AS ( SELECT el.account_id, el.amount FROM EligibleLoans el JOIN EligibleAccounts ea ON el.account_id = ea.account_id ), MinApprovedAmount AS ( SELECT MIN(amount) AS min_amount FROM CombinedEligible ) SELECT DISTINCT ce.account_id FROM CombinedEligible ce JOIN MinApprovedAmount mpa ON ce.amount = mpa.min_amount

WITH OldestFemale AS ( SELECT MIN(birth_date) AS min_birth_date FROM financial.client WHERE gender = 'F' ), LowestAvgSalaryDistrict AS ( SELECT MIN(a11) AS min_avg_salary FROM financial.district ) SELECT DISTINCT a.account_id FROM financial.client c JOIN financial.district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id JOIN financial.disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id JOIN financial.account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id WHERE c.gender = 'F' AND c.birth_date = ( SELECT min_birth_date FROM OldestFemale ) AND d.a11 = ( SELECT min_avg_salary FROM LowestAvgSalaryDistrict )
SELECT COUNT(T1.client_id) FROM financial.client T1 INNER JOIN financial.district T2 ON T1.district_id = T2.district_id WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM T1.birth_date) = 1920 AND T2.a3 = 'east Bohemia'
SELECT COUNT(T1.loan_id) FROM financial.loan T1 INNER JOIN financial.account T2 ON T1.account_id = T2.account_id WHERE T1.duration = 24 AND T2.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'
SELECT AVG(l.amount) FROM financial.loan l WHERE l.status IN ('C', 'D') AND l.account_id IN ( SELECT DISTINCT t.account_id FROM financial.trans t WHERE t.k_symbol = 'SLUZBY' )
SELECT T1.client_id, T1.district_id FROM financial.client T1 INNER JOIN financial.disp T2 ON T1.client_id = T2.client_id WHERE T2.type = 'OWNER'

SELECT c.client_id, TRUNC(MONTHS_BETWEEN(SYSDATE, c.birth_date) / 12) AS age FROM financial.client c JOIN financial.disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id JOIN financial.card ca ON d.disp_id = ca.disp_id WHERE ca.type = 'gold' AND d.type = 'OWNER'
SELECT bond_type FROM toxicology.bond GROUP BY bond_type ORDER BY COUNT(bond_type) DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.molecule_id) FROM toxicology.molecule T1 INNER JOIN toxicology.atom T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T1.label = '-' AND T2.element = 'cl'

WITH SingleBondedMolecules AS ( SELECT DISTINCT bond.molecule_id FROM toxicology.bond WHERE bond.bond_type = '-' ), OxygenCountsPerMolecule AS ( SELECT sbm.molecule_id, COUNT(CASE WHEN atom.element = 'o' THEN 1 END) AS oxygen_atom_count FROM SingleBondedMolecules sbm JOIN toxicology.atom atom ON sbm.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id GROUP BY sbm.molecule_id ) SELECT AVG(ocpm.oxygen_atom_count) FROM OxygenCountsPerMolecule ocpm

SELECT AVG(single_bond_count) FROM (SELECT m.molecule_id, COUNT(b.bond_id) AS single_bond_count FROM toxicology.molecule m JOIN toxicology.bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id WHERE m.label = '+' AND b.bond_type = '-' GROUP BY m.molecule_id )
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.molecule_id) FROM toxicology.molecule T1 INNER JOIN toxicology.atom T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T2.element = 'na' AND T1.label = '-'
SELECT m.molecule_id FROM toxicology.molecule m JOIN toxicology.bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id WHERE b.bond_type = '#' AND m.label = '+'

WITH DoubleBondMolecules AS ( SELECT DISTINCT b.molecule_id FROM toxicology.bond b WHERE b.bond_type = '=' ) SELECT (SUM(CASE WHEN a.element = 'c' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(a.atom_id)) * 100 FROM toxicology.atom a JOIN DoubleBondMolecules dbm ON a.molecule_id = dbm.molecule_id
SELECT COUNT(T1.bond_id) FROM toxicology.bond T1 WHERE T1.bond_type = '#'
SELECT COUNT(T1.atom_id) FROM toxicology.atom T1 WHERE T1.element <> 'br'
SELECT COUNT(m.molecule_id) FROM toxicology.molecule m WHERE m.molecule_id BETWEEN 'TR000' AND 'TR099' AND m.label = '+'
SELECT DISTINCT T1.molecule_id FROM toxicology.molecule T1 INNER JOIN toxicology.atom T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T2.element = 'c'

SELECT DISTINCT T2.element FROM toxicology.connected T1 INNER JOIN toxicology.atom T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id WHERE T1.bond_id = 'TR004_8_9' UNION SELECT DISTINCT T2.element FROM toxicology.connected T1 INNER JOIN toxicology.atom T2 ON T1.atom_id2 = T2.atom_id WHERE T1.bond_id = 'TR004_8_9'

SELECT DISTINCT a.element FROM toxicology.bond b JOIN toxicology.connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id JOIN toxicology.atom a ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id WHERE b.bond_type = '=' UNION SELECT DISTINCT a2.element FROM toxicology.bond b JOIN toxicology.connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id JOIN toxicology.atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id WHERE b.bond_type = '='

WITH MoleculesWithHydrogen AS ( SELECT DISTINCT a.molecule_id FROM toxicology.atom a WHERE a.element = 'h' ), LabelCounts AS ( SELECT m.label, COUNT(m.label) AS label_count FROM MoleculesWithHydrogen mwh JOIN toxicology.molecule m ON mwh.molecule_id = m.molecule_id GROUP BY m.label ) SELECT label FROM ( SELECT lc.label FROM LabelCounts lc ORDER BY lc.label_count DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM = 1

SELECT DISTINCT T1.bond_type FROM toxicology.bond T1 INNER JOIN toxicology.connected T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id INNER JOIN toxicology.atom T3 ON T2.atom_id = T3.atom_id WHERE T3.element = 'cl' UNION SELECT DISTINCT T1.bond_type FROM toxicology.bond T1 INNER JOIN toxicology.connected T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id INNER JOIN toxicology.atom T3 ON T2.atom_id2 = T3.atom_id WHERE T3.element = 'cl'
SELECT T1.atom_id, T1.atom_id2 FROM toxicology.connected T1 INNER JOIN toxicology.bond T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id WHERE T2.bond_type = '-'
SELECT c.atom_id, c.atom_id2 FROM toxicology.connected c JOIN toxicology.bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id JOIN toxicology.molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id WHERE m.label = '-'

WITH NonCarcinogenicMolecules AS ( SELECT m.molecule_id FROM toxicology.molecule m WHERE m.label = '-' ), ElementCounts AS ( SELECT a.element, COUNT(a.element) AS element_count FROM toxicology.atom a JOIN NonCarcinogenicMolecules ncm ON a.molecule_id = ncm.molecule_id GROUP BY a.element ) SELECT ec.element FROM ElementCounts ec ORDER BY ec.element_count ASC FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY

SELECT T1.bond_type FROM toxicology.bond T1 INNER JOIN toxicology.connected T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id WHERE ( T2.atom_id = 'TR004_8' AND T2.atom_id2 = 'TR004_20' ) OR ( T2.atom_id = 'TR004_20' AND T2.atom_id2 = 'TR004_8' )
SELECT m.label FROM toxicology.molecule m MINUS SELECT m.label FROM toxicology.molecule m JOIN toxicology.atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id WHERE a.element = 'sn'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.atom_id) FROM toxicology.atom a JOIN ( SELECT b.molecule_id FROM toxicology.bond b GROUP BY b.molecule_id HAVING MAX(CASE WHEN b.bond_type != '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0 ) single_bond_molecules ON a.molecule_id = single_bond_molecules.molecule_id WHERE a.element IN ('i', 's')
SELECT T1.atom_id, T1.atom_id2 FROM toxicology.connected T1 INNER JOIN toxicology.bond T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id WHERE T2.bond_type = '#'

WITH TR181_atoms AS ( SELECT atom_id FROM toxicology.atom WHERE molecule_id = 'TR181' ), RelevantConnections AS ( SELECT c.atom_id AS a1, c.atom_id2 AS a2 FROM toxicology.connected c -- Removed 'AS' keyword for table alias WHERE c.atom_id IN (SELECT atom_id FROM TR181_atoms) OR c.atom_id2 IN (SELECT atom_id FROM TR181_atoms) ) SELECT DISTINCT a1 AS connected_atom_id FROM RelevantConnections UNION SELECT DISTINCT a2 AS connected_atom_id FROM RelevantConnections

WITH carcinogenic_molecules AS ( SELECT molecule_id FROM toxicology.molecule WHERE label = '+' ), molecules_with_fluorine AS ( SELECT DISTINCT a.molecule_id FROM toxicology.atom a WHERE a.element = 'f' ) SELECT ( CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN mwf.molecule_id IS NULL THEN cm.molecule_id END) AS NUMBER) * 100.0 ) / NULLIF(CAST(COUNT(cm.molecule_id) AS NUMBER), 0) FROM carcinogenic_molecules cm LEFT JOIN molecules_with_fluorine mwf ON cm.molecule_id = mwf.molecule_id
SELECT (SUM(CASE WHEN T2.bond_type = '#' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0) / COUNT(T2.bond_id) FROM toxicology.molecule T1 JOIN toxicology.bond T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T1.label = '+'

SELECT element FROM ( SELECT a.element, COUNT(a.element) AS element_count FROM toxicology.atom a WHERE a.molecule_id = 'TR000' GROUP BY a.element ORDER BY element_count DESC, a.element ASC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 3
SELECT T1.atom_id, T1.atom_id2 FROM toxicology.connected T1 WHERE T1.bond_id = 'TR001_2_6'
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN T1.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN T1.label = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM toxicology.molecule T1
SELECT T1.atom_id, T1.atom_id2 FROM toxicology.connected T1 WHERE T1.bond_id = 'TR000_2_5'
SELECT T1.bond_id FROM toxicology.connected T1 WHERE T1.atom_id2 IN ( SELECT T2.atom_id2 FROM toxicology.connected T2 WHERE T2.atom_id = 'TR000_2' )
SELECT DISTINCT T2.label FROM toxicology.bond T1 INNER JOIN toxicology.molecule T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T1.bond_type = '=' ORDER BY T2.label FETCH FIRST 5 ROWS ONLY
SELECT ROUND( (SUM(CASE WHEN b.bond_type = '=' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(b.bond_id)) * 100, 5 ) FROM toxicology.bond b WHERE b.molecule_id = 'TR008'
SELECT TO_CHAR( (SUM(CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(m.molecule_id)) * 100, 'FM990.000' ) FROM toxicology.molecule m
SELECT ROUND( (SUM(CASE WHEN T1.element = 'h' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(T1.atom_id)) * 100, 4 ) FROM toxicology.atom T1 WHERE T1.molecule_id = 'TR206'
SELECT T1.bond_type FROM toxicology.bond T1 INNER JOIN toxicology.molecule T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T2.molecule_id = 'TR000'
SELECT DISTINCT T1.element, T2.label FROM toxicology.atom T1 INNER JOIN toxicology.molecule T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T1.molecule_id = 'TR060'

WITH MoleculeBonds AS ( SELECT b.bond_type, m.label FROM toxicology.bond b JOIN toxicology.molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id WHERE b.molecule_id = 'TR010' ), BondTypeCounts AS ( SELECT bond_type, COUNT(*) AS bond_count, MAX(label) AS molecule_label -- label is constant for TR010 FROM MoleculeBonds GROUP BY bond_type ), RankedBondTypes AS ( SELECT bond_type, molecule_label, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY bond_count DESC) AS rnk FROM BondTypeCounts ) SELECT bond_type, molecule_label FROM RankedBondTypes WHERE rnk = 1

SELECT m.molecule_id FROM toxicology.molecule m JOIN toxicology.bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id WHERE m.label = '-' AND b.bond_type = '-' GROUP BY m.molecule_id ORDER BY m.molecule_id FETCH FIRST 3 ROWS ONLY
SELECT bond_id FROM toxicology.bond WHERE molecule_id = 'TR006' ORDER BY bond_id FETCH FIRST 2 ROWS ONLY

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.bond_id) FROM toxicology.bond T1 INNER JOIN toxicology.connected T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id WHERE T1.molecule_id = 'TR009' AND (T2.atom_id = 'TR009_12' OR T2.atom_id2 = 'TR009_12')
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id) FROM toxicology.molecule m JOIN toxicology.atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id WHERE m.label = '+' AND a.element = 'br'
SELECT T1.bond_type, T2.atom_id, T2.atom_id2 FROM toxicology.bond T1 INNER JOIN toxicology.connected T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id WHERE T1.bond_id = 'TR001_6_9'
SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label FROM toxicology.atom a JOIN toxicology.molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id WHERE a.atom_id = 'TR001_10'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.molecule_id) FROM toxicology.bond T1 WHERE T1.bond_type = '#'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.bond_id) FROM toxicology.connected T1 WHERE T1.atom_id LIKE 'TR%_19' OR T1.atom_id2 LIKE 'TR%_19'
SELECT DISTINCT T2.element FROM toxicology.molecule T1 INNER JOIN toxicology.atom T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T1.molecule_id = 'TR004'
SELECT COUNT(molecule_id) FROM toxicology.molecule WHERE label = '-'
SELECT DISTINCT T1.molecule_id FROM toxicology.atom T1 INNER JOIN toxicology.molecule T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE SUBSTR(T1.atom_id, 7, 2) BETWEEN '21' AND '25' AND T2.label = '+'

SELECT T1.bond_id FROM toxicology.connected T1 INNER JOIN toxicology.atom T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id INNER JOIN toxicology.atom T3 ON T1.atom_id2 = T3.atom_id WHERE ( T2.element = 'p' AND T3.element = 'n' ) OR ( T2.element = 'n' AND T3.element = 'p' )

WITH DoubleBondCounts AS ( SELECT b.molecule_id, COUNT(b.bond_id) AS double_bond_count FROM toxicology.bond b WHERE b.bond_type = '=' GROUP BY b.molecule_id ), MaxDoubleBondMolecule AS ( SELECT dbc.molecule_id FROM DoubleBondCounts dbc ORDER BY dbc.double_bond_count DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY ) SELECT CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END FROM toxicology.molecule m JOIN MaxDoubleBondMolecule mdbm ON m.molecule_id = mdbm.molecule_id

SELECT AVG(bond_count) FROM ( SELECT a.atom_id, COUNT(DISTINCT c.bond_id) AS bond_count FROM toxicology.atom a LEFT JOIN toxicology.connected c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id OR a.atom_id = c.atom_id2 WHERE a.element = 'i' GROUP BY a.atom_id )

SELECT DISTINCT T3.bond_type, T3.bond_id FROM toxicology.atom T1 INNER JOIN toxicology.connected T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id OR T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id2 INNER JOIN toxicology.bond T3 ON T2.bond_id = T3.bond_id WHERE SUBSTR(T1.atom_id, 7, 2) + 0 = 45
SELECT DISTINCT T1.element FROM toxicology.atom T1 WHERE T1.atom_id NOT IN ( SELECT T2.atom_id FROM toxicology.connected T2 ) AND T1.atom_id NOT IN ( SELECT T3.atom_id2 FROM toxicology.connected T3 )

SELECT a1.element, a2.element FROM toxicology.bond b JOIN toxicology.connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id JOIN toxicology.atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id JOIN toxicology.atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id WHERE b.molecule_id = 'TR041' AND b.bond_type = '#'

SELECT a.element FROM toxicology.connected c JOIN toxicology.atom a ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR144_8_19' UNION SELECT a2.element FROM toxicology.connected c JOIN toxicology.atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR144_8_19'

SELECT m.molecule_id FROM toxicology.molecule m JOIN toxicology.bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id WHERE m.label = '+' AND b.bond_type = '=' GROUP BY m.molecule_id ORDER BY COUNT(b.bond_id) DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY

WITH CarcinogenicMolecules AS ( SELECT molecule_id FROM toxicology.molecule WHERE label = '+' ), ElementCounts AS ( SELECT a.element, COUNT(a.element) AS element_occurrence_count FROM toxicology.atom a JOIN CarcinogenicMolecules cm ON a.molecule_id = cm.molecule_id GROUP BY a.element ) SELECT element FROM ElementCounts ORDER BY element_occurrence_count ASC FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY

SELECT DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.atom_id = a_pb.atom_id THEN c.atom_id2 ELSE c.atom_id END AS connected_atom_id FROM toxicology.atom a_pb JOIN toxicology.connected c ON a_pb.atom_id = c.atom_id OR a_pb.atom_id = c.atom_id2 WHERE a_pb.element = 'pb'

SELECT DISTINCT a1.element FROM toxicology.bond b JOIN toxicology.connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id JOIN toxicology.atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id WHERE b.bond_type = '#' UNION SELECT DISTINCT a2.element FROM toxicology.bond b JOIN toxicology.connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id JOIN toxicology.atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id WHERE b.bond_type = '#'

WITH BondElementCombinations AS ( SELECT b.bond_id, LEAST(a1.element, a2.element) AS element_a, GREATEST(a1.element, a2.element) AS element_b FROM toxicology.bond b JOIN toxicology.connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id JOIN toxicology.atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id JOIN toxicology.atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id ), CombinationCounts AS ( SELECT element_a, element_b, COUNT(bond_id) AS combination_count FROM BondElementCombinations GROUP BY element_a, element_b ), MostCommonCombinationInfo AS ( SELECT combination_count AS most_common_bond_count FROM CombinationCounts ORDER BY combination_count DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY ) SELECT (mcci.most_common_bond_count * 100.0) / (SELECT COUNT(bond_id) FROM BondElementCombinations) FROM MostCommonCombinationInfo mcci
SELECT ROUND( (SUM(CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(b.bond_id)) * 100, 5 ) FROM toxicology.bond b JOIN toxicology.molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id WHERE b.bond_type = '-'
SELECT COUNT(T1.atom_id) FROM toxicology.atom T1 WHERE T1.element IN ('c', 'h')
SELECT T1.atom_id2 FROM toxicology.connected T1 INNER JOIN toxicology.atom T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id WHERE T2.element = 's'

SELECT DISTINCT T3.bond_type FROM toxicology.atom T1 INNER JOIN toxicology.connected T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id OR T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id2 INNER JOIN toxicology.bond T3 ON T2.bond_id = T3.bond_id WHERE T1.element = 'sn'

WITH MoleculesWithNonSingleBonds AS ( SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id FROM toxicology.bond WHERE bond_type != '-' ), SingleBondOnlyMolecules AS ( SELECT DISTINCT b.molecule_id FROM toxicology.bond b WHERE b.molecule_id NOT IN ( SELECT molecule_id FROM MoleculesWithNonSingleBonds ) ) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.element) FROM toxicology.atom a JOIN SingleBondOnlyMolecules sbo ON a.molecule_id = sbo.molecule_id

WITH TripleBondMolecules AS ( SELECT DISTINCT b.molecule_id FROM toxicology.bond b WHERE b.bond_type = '#' ), ElementMolecules AS ( SELECT DISTINCT a.molecule_id FROM toxicology.atom a WHERE a.element IN ('p', 'br') ) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.atom_id) FROM toxicology.atom a JOIN TripleBondMolecules tbm ON a.molecule_id = tbm.molecule_id JOIN ElementMolecules em ON a.molecule_id = em.molecule_id
SELECT T1.bond_id FROM toxicology.bond T1 INNER JOIN toxicology.molecule T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T2.label = '+'
SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id FROM toxicology.molecule m JOIN toxicology.bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id WHERE m.label = '-' AND b.bond_type = '-'

WITH SingleBondMolecules AS ( SELECT DISTINCT bond.molecule_id FROM toxicology.bond WHERE bond.bond_type = '-' ) SELECT (SUM(CASE WHEN atom.element = 'cl' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0) / COUNT(atom.atom_id) FROM toxicology.atom JOIN SingleBondMolecules ON atom.molecule_id = SingleBondMolecules.molecule_id
SELECT molecule.label FROM toxicology.molecule molecule WHERE molecule.molecule_id IN ('TR000', 'TR001', 'TR002')
SELECT molecule_id FROM toxicology.molecule WHERE label = '-'
SELECT COUNT(T1.molecule_id) FROM toxicology.molecule T1 WHERE T1.label = '+' AND T1.molecule_id BETWEEN 'TR000' AND 'TR030'
SELECT T1.bond_type FROM toxicology.bond T1 JOIN toxicology.molecule T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T1.molecule_id BETWEEN 'TR000' AND 'TR050'
SELECT a1.element, a2.element FROM toxicology.connected c JOIN toxicology.atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id JOIN toxicology.atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR001_10_11'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.bond_id) FROM toxicology.connected T1 INNER JOIN toxicology.atom T2_atom1 ON T1.atom_id = T2_atom1.atom_id INNER JOIN toxicology.atom T2_atom2 ON T1.atom_id2 = T2_atom2.atom_id WHERE T2_atom1.element = 'i' OR T2_atom2.element = 'i'

WITH CalciumMolecules AS ( SELECT DISTINCT a.molecule_id FROM toxicology.atom a WHERE a.element = 'ca' ), CarcinogenicCounts AS ( SELECT m.label, COUNT(m.molecule_id) AS molecule_count FROM toxicology.molecule m JOIN CalciumMolecules cm ON m.molecule_id = cm.molecule_id GROUP BY m.label ) SELECT label FROM CarcinogenicCounts ORDER BY molecule_count DESC, label DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY

SELECT CASE WHEN (a1.element = 'cl' AND a2.element = 'c') OR (a1.element = 'c' AND a2.element = 'cl') THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END FROM toxicology.connected c JOIN toxicology.atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id JOIN toxicology.atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR001_1_8'

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id FROM toxicology.molecule m JOIN toxicology.bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id JOIN toxicology.connected con ON b.bond_id = con.bond_id JOIN toxicology.atom a1 ON con.atom_id = a1.atom_id JOIN toxicology.atom a2 ON con.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id WHERE m.label = '-' AND b.bond_type = '#' AND ( a1.element = 'c' OR a2.element = 'c' ) FETCH FIRST 2 ROWS ONLY
SELECT (SUM(CASE WHEN a.element = 'cl' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0) / COUNT(a.atom_id) FROM toxicology.molecule m JOIN toxicology.atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id WHERE m.label = '+'
SELECT DISTINCT T2.element FROM toxicology.molecule T1 INNER JOIN toxicology.atom T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T1.molecule_id = 'TR001'
SELECT bond.molecule_id FROM toxicology.bond bond WHERE bond.bond_type = '='
SELECT T1.atom_id, T1.atom_id2 FROM toxicology.connected T1 INNER JOIN toxicology.bond T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id WHERE T2.bond_type = '#'

SELECT T2.element FROM toxicology.connected T1 INNER JOIN toxicology.atom T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id WHERE T1.bond_id = 'TR000_1_2' UNION SELECT T2.element FROM toxicology.connected T1 INNER JOIN toxicology.atom T2 ON T1.atom_id2 = T2.atom_id WHERE T1.bond_id = 'TR000_1_2'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id) FROM toxicology.molecule m JOIN toxicology.bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id WHERE m.label = '-' AND b.bond_type = '-'

SELECT d.forename, d.surname, d.url FROM formula_1.races r JOIN formula_1.results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid JOIN formula_1.drivers d ON res.driverid = d.driverid WHERE r.year = 2008 AND r.name = 'Australian Grand Prix' AND res.position = 1
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.driverid) FROM formula_1.drivers T1 INNER JOIN formula_1.qualifying T2 ON T1.driverid = T2.driverid WHERE T1.nationality = 'British' AND T2.raceid = 18
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.driverid) FROM formula_1.results T1 INNER JOIN formula_1.races T2 ON T1.raceid = T2.raceid WHERE T2.year = 2008 AND T2.name = 'Chinese Grand Prix' AND T1.time IS NOT NULL
SELECT SUM(T1.points) FROM formula_1.results T1 WHERE T1.driverid = 1

SELECT AVG( TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(T1.fastestlaptime, 1, INSTR(T1.fastestlaptime, ':') - 1)) * 60 + TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(T1.fastestlaptime, INSTR(T1.fastestlaptime, ':') + 1)) ) AS average_fastest_lap_time_seconds FROM formula_1.results T1 WHERE T1.driverid = 1 AND T1.fastestlaptime IS NOT NULL

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T2.time IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS NUMBER) / COUNT(T2.driverid) FROM formula_1.races T1 INNER JOIN formula_1.results T2 ON T1.raceid = T2.raceid WHERE T1.year = 2008 AND T1.name = 'Australian Grand Prix'

WITH australian_gp_2008 AS ( SELECT raceid FROM formula_1.races WHERE year = 2008 AND name = 'Australian Grand Prix' ), race_finishers AS ( SELECT r.milliseconds, r.positionorder FROM formula_1.results r JOIN australian_gp_2008 agp ON r.raceid = agp.raceid WHERE r.milliseconds IS NOT NULL ), champion_time AS ( SELECT milliseconds AS champion_ms FROM race_finishers WHERE positionorder = 1 ), last_finisher_time AS ( SELECT milliseconds AS last_ms FROM race_finishers ORDER BY positionorder DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY ) SELECT ((lft.last_ms - ct.champion_ms) / lft.last_ms) * 100 FROM champion_time ct, last_finisher_time lft
SELECT COUNT(T1.circuitid) FROM formula_1.circuits T1 WHERE T1.location = 'Adelaide' AND T1.country = 'Australia'
SELECT T1.lat, T1.lng FROM formula_1.circuits T1 WHERE T1.country = 'USA'
SELECT COUNT(driverid) FROM formula_1.drivers WHERE nationality = 'British' AND dob > DATE '1980-12-31'
SELECT MAX(cs.points) FROM formula_1.constructorstandings cs JOIN formula_1.constructors c ON cs.constructorid = c.constructorid WHERE c.nationality = 'British'
SELECT T1.name FROM formula_1.constructors T1 INNER JOIN formula_1.constructorstandings T2 ON T1.constructorid = T2.constructorid GROUP BY T1.name ORDER BY SUM(T2.points) DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY
SELECT T1.name FROM formula_1.constructors T1 INNER JOIN formula_1.constructorresults T2 ON T1.constructorid = T2.constructorid WHERE T2.raceid = 291 AND T2.points = 0

SELECT COUNT(T1.constructorid) FROM formula_1.constructors T1 INNER JOIN formula_1.constructorresults T2 ON T1.constructorid = T2.constructorid WHERE T1.nationality = 'Japanese' AND T2.points = 0 GROUP BY T1.constructorid HAVING COUNT(T2.raceid) = 2
SELECT DISTINCT T1.name FROM formula_1.constructors T1 INNER JOIN formula_1.results T2 ON T1.constructorid = T2.constructorid WHERE T2.rank = 1
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.constructorid) FROM formula_1.constructors T1 INNER JOIN formula_1.results T2 ON T1.constructorid = T2.constructorid WHERE T1.nationality = 'French' AND T2.laps > 50

SELECT ( CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN T3.time IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS NUMBER) / COUNT(T3.driverid) ) * 100 FROM formula_1.drivers T1 INNER JOIN formula_1.results T3 ON T1.driverid = T3.driverid INNER JOIN formula_1.races T2 ON T3.raceid = T2.raceid WHERE T1.nationality = 'Japanese' AND T2.year BETWEEN 2007 AND 2009

WITH ChampionTimes AS ( SELECT r.year, TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(res.time, 1, INSTR(res.time, ':') - 1)) AS hours, TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(res.time, INSTR(res.time, ':') + 1, INSTR(res.time, ':', 1, 2) - (INSTR(res.time, ':') + 1))) AS minutes, TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(res.time, INSTR(res.time, ':', 1, 2) + 1)) AS seconds_with_ms FROM formula_1.races r JOIN formula_1.results res ON r.raceid = res.raceid WHERE r.year < 1975 AND res.position = 1 AND res.time IS NOT NULL ) SELECT year, AVG(hours * 3600 + minutes * 60 + seconds_with_ms) FROM ChampionTimes GROUP BY year ORDER BY year
SELECT DISTINCT d.forename, d.surname FROM formula_1.drivers d JOIN formula_1.driverstandings ds ON d.driverid = ds.driverid WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM d.dob) > 1975 AND ds.position = 2
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.driverid) FROM formula_1.drivers T1 INNER JOIN formula_1.results T2 ON T1.driverid = T2.driverid WHERE T1.nationality = 'Italian' AND T2.time IS NULL

SELECT d.forename, d.surname FROM formula_1.drivers d JOIN formula_1.laptimes lt ON d.driverid = lt.driverid WHERE lt.milliseconds = ( SELECT MIN(milliseconds) FROM formula_1.laptimes WHERE milliseconds IS NOT NULL )
SELECT T2.fastestlap FROM formula_1.races T1 INNER JOIN formula_1.results T2 ON T1.raceid = T2.raceid WHERE T1.year = 2009 AND T2.position = 1
SELECT AVG(TO_NUMBER(T2.fastestlapspeed)) FROM formula_1.races T1 INNER JOIN formula_1.results T2 ON T1.raceid = T2.raceid WHERE T1.name = 'Spanish Grand Prix' AND T1.year = 2009
SELECT T1.name, T1.year FROM formula_1.races T1 INNER JOIN formula_1.results T2 ON T1.raceid = T2.raceid WHERE T2.milliseconds IS NOT NULL ORDER BY T2.milliseconds FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY

WITH DriverStats AS ( SELECT d.driverid, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM d.dob) AS dob_year, r.year AS race_year, res.laps FROM formula_1.drivers d JOIN formula_1.results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN formula_1.races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid WHERE r.year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2005 ) SELECT (COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ds.dob_year < 1985 AND ds.laps > 50 THEN ds.driverid END) * 100.0) / COUNT(DISTINCT ds.driverid) FROM DriverStats ds
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.driverid) FROM formula_1.drivers T1 INNER JOIN formula_1.laptimes T2 ON T1.driverid = T2.driverid WHERE T1.nationality = 'French' AND T2.milliseconds < 120000
SELECT code FROM formula_1.drivers WHERE nationality = 'America'
SELECT T1.raceid FROM formula_1.races T1 WHERE T1.year = 2009
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.driverid) FROM formula_1.results T1 WHERE T1.raceid = 18

WITH YoungestDrivers AS ( SELECT d.code, d.nationality, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY d.dob DESC) AS rn FROM formula_1.drivers d ) SELECT LISTAGG(yd.code, ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY yd.rn) AS top_3_youngest_driver_codes, SUM(CASE WHEN yd.nationality IN ('Dutch', 'Netherlandic') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS netherlandic_drivers_count FROM YoungestDrivers yd WHERE yd.rn <= 3
SELECT T1.driverref FROM formula_1.drivers T1 WHERE T1.forename = 'Robert' AND T1.surname = 'Kubica'
SELECT COUNT(driverid) FROM formula_1.drivers WHERE nationality = 'British' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM dob) = 1980

WITH GermanDriversBorn1980_1990 AS ( SELECT d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname FROM formula_1.drivers d WHERE d.nationality = 'German' AND TO_CHAR(d.dob, 'YYYY') BETWEEN '1980' AND '1990' ), DriverMinLapTime AS ( SELECT gd.driverid, gd.forename, gd.surname, MIN(lt.milliseconds) AS min_lap_milliseconds FROM GermanDriversBorn1980_1990 gd JOIN formula_1.laptimes lt ON gd.driverid = lt.driverid GROUP BY gd.driverid, gd.forename, gd.surname ) SELECT d.forename, d.surname FROM DriverMinLapTime d ORDER BY d.min_lap_milliseconds ASC FETCH FIRST 3 ROWS ONLY
SELECT d.driverref FROM formula_1.drivers d WHERE d.nationality = 'German' ORDER BY d.dob ASC FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY
SELECT DISTINCT d.driverid, d.code FROM formula_1.drivers d JOIN formula_1.results r ON d.driverid = r.driverid WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM d.dob) = 1971 AND r.fastestlaptime IS NOT NULL

SELECT d.forename, d.surname FROM formula_1.drivers d JOIN formula_1.laptimes lt ON d.driverid = lt.driverid WHERE d.nationality = 'Spanish' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM d.dob) < 1982 GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname ORDER BY MAX(lt.time) DESC FETCH FIRST 10 ROWS ONLY

WITH ConvertedLapTimes AS ( SELECT r.year, CASE WHEN INSTR(res.fastestlaptime, ':') > 0 THEN TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(res.fastestlaptime, 1, INSTR(res.fastestlaptime, ':') - 1)) * 60 * 1000 + TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(res.fastestlaptime, INSTR(res.fastestlaptime, ':') + 1)) * 1000 ELSE TO_NUMBER(res.fastestlaptime) * 1000 END AS fastest_lap_milliseconds FROM formula_1.results res JOIN formula_1.races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid WHERE res.fastestlaptime IS NOT NULL ) SELECT year FROM ConvertedLapTimes WHERE fastest_lap_milliseconds = (SELECT MIN(fastest_lap_milliseconds) FROM ConvertedLapTimes)
SELECT r.year FROM formula_1.laptimes lt JOIN formula_1.races r ON lt.raceid = r.raceid WHERE lt.milliseconds = ( SELECT MAX(milliseconds) FROM formula_1.laptimes )
SELECT driverid FROM formula_1.laptimes WHERE lap = 1 ORDER BY milliseconds ASC FETCH FIRST 5 ROWS ONLY
SELECT COUNT(T1.resultid) FROM formula_1.results T1 WHERE T1.raceid >= 50 AND T1.raceid < 100 AND T1.statusid = 2 AND T1.time IS NOT NULL

WITH AustrianCircuitRaces AS ( SELECT c.circuitid, c.name AS circuit_name, c.location, c.lat, c.lng, COUNT(r.raceid) AS races_held_at_circuit FROM formula_1.circuits c JOIN formula_1.races r ON c.circuitid = r.circuitid WHERE c.country = 'Austria' GROUP BY c.circuitid, c.name, c.location, c.lat, c.lng ) SELECT acr.circuit_name, acr.location, acr.lat, acr.lng, acr.races_held_at_circuit, SUM(acr.races_held_at_circuit) OVER () AS total_races_in_austria FROM AustrianCircuitRaces acr
SELECT r.raceid FROM formula_1.results r WHERE r.time IS NOT NULL GROUP BY r.raceid ORDER BY COUNT(r.driverid) DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY
SELECT T1.driverref, T1.nationality, T1.dob FROM formula_1.drivers T1 INNER JOIN formula_1.qualifying T2 ON T1.driverid = T2.driverid WHERE T2.raceid = 23 AND T2.q2 IS NOT NULL

WITH YoungestDriver AS ( SELECT driverid FROM formula_1.drivers ORDER BY dob DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY ) SELECT r.year, r.name, r."DATE", r.time FROM formula_1.qualifying q JOIN formula_1.races r ON q.raceid = r.raceid JOIN YoungestDriver yd ON q.driverid = yd.driverid ORDER BY r."DATE" ASC FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.driverid) FROM formula_1.drivers T1 INNER JOIN formula_1.results T2 ON T1.driverid = T2.driverid INNER JOIN formula_1.status T3 ON T2.statusid = T3.statusid WHERE T1.nationality = 'American' AND T3.status = 'Puncture'

SELECT T1.name, T1.url FROM formula_1.constructors T1 INNER JOIN formula_1.constructorresults T2 ON T1.constructorid = T2.constructorid WHERE T1.nationality = 'Italian' GROUP BY T1.name, T1.url ORDER BY SUM(T2.points) DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY

SELECT c.url FROM formula_1.constructors c JOIN ( SELECT constructorid, SUM(wins) AS total_wins FROM formula_1.constructorstandings GROUP BY constructorid ORDER BY total_wins DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY ) top_constructor ON c.constructorid = top_constructor.constructorid

SELECT T2.forename, T2.surname FROM formula_1.laptimes T1 INNER JOIN formula_1.drivers T2 ON T1.driverid = T2.driverid INNER JOIN formula_1.races T3 ON T1.raceid = T3.raceid WHERE T3.name = 'French Grand Prix' AND T1.lap = 3 ORDER BY T1.milliseconds DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY

SELECT r.name, lt.milliseconds FROM formula_1.laptimes lt JOIN formula_1.races r ON lt.raceid = r.raceid WHERE lt.lap = 1 AND lt.milliseconds = ( SELECT MIN(milliseconds) FROM formula_1.laptimes WHERE lap = 1 )

WITH RaceFastestLaps AS ( SELECT CASE WHEN INSTR(res.fastestlaptime, ':') > 0 THEN TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(res.fastestlaptime, 1, INSTR(res.fastestlaptime, ':') - 1)) * 60 * 1000 + TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(res.fastestlaptime, INSTR(res.fastestlaptime, ':') + 1)) * 1000 ELSE TO_NUMBER(res.fastestlaptime) * 1000 END AS fastest_lap_ms FROM formula_1.results res JOIN formula_1.races ra ON res.raceid = ra.raceid WHERE ra.year = 2006 AND ra.name = 'United States Grand Prix' AND res.rank <= 10 AND res.fastestlaptime IS NOT NULL ), AverageFastestLapMs AS ( SELECT AVG(fastest_lap_ms) AS avg_ms FROM RaceFastestLaps ) SELECT TO_CHAR(FLOOR(avg_ms / 60000)) || ':' || TO_CHAR(MOD(FLOOR(avg_ms / 1000), 60), 'FM00') || '.' || TO_CHAR(MOD(avg_ms, 1000), 'FM000') FROM AverageFastestLapMs

SELECT d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_full_name FROM formula_1.drivers d JOIN formula_1.pitstops ps ON d.driverid = ps.driverid WHERE d.nationality = 'German' AND d.dob BETWEEN TO_DATE('1980-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND TO_DATE('1985-12-31', 'YYYY-MM-DD') GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname ORDER BY AVG(ps.milliseconds) FETCH FIRST 3 ROWS ONLY
SELECT T2.time FROM formula_1.races T1 INNER JOIN formula_1.results T2 ON T1.raceid = T2.raceid WHERE T1.name = 'Canadian Grand Prix' AND T1.year = 2008 AND T2.position = 1

SELECT T2.constructorref, T2.url FROM formula_1.races T1 INNER JOIN formula_1.results T3 ON T1.raceid = T3.raceid INNER JOIN formula_1.constructors T2 ON T3.constructorid = T2.constructorid WHERE T1.year = 2009 AND T1.name = 'Singapore Grand Prix' AND T3.position = 1
SELECT d.forename, d.surname, d.dob FROM formula_1.drivers d WHERE d.nationality = 'Austrian' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM d.dob) BETWEEN 1981 AND 1991
SELECT d.forename || ' ' || d.surname, d.url, d.dob FROM formula_1.drivers d WHERE d.nationality = 'German' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM d.dob) BETWEEN 1971 AND 1985 ORDER BY d.dob DESC
SELECT T1.location, T1.country, T1.lat, T1.lng FROM formula_1.circuits T1 WHERE T1.name = 'Hungaroring'

WITH MonacoGPPoints AS ( SELECT cr.constructorid, SUM(cr.points) AS total_points FROM formula_1.races r JOIN formula_1.constructorresults cr ON r.raceid = cr.raceid WHERE r.name = 'Monaco Grand Prix' AND r.year BETWEEN 1980 AND 2010 GROUP BY cr.constructorid ) SELECT mgp.total_points, c.name, c.nationality FROM MonacoGPPoints mgp JOIN formula_1.constructors c ON mgp.constructorid = c.constructorid ORDER BY mgp.total_points DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY

SELECT AVG(T1.points) FROM formula_1.results T1 INNER JOIN formula_1.drivers T2 ON T1.driverid = T2.driverid INNER JOIN formula_1.races T3 ON T1.raceid = T3.raceid INNER JOIN formula_1.circuits T4 ON T3.circuitid = T4.circuitid WHERE T2.forename = 'Lewis' AND T2.surname = 'Hamilton' AND T4.name LIKE '%Turkey%'
SELECT AVG(races_per_year.num_races) FROM ( SELECT r.year, COUNT(r.raceid) AS num_races FROM formula_1.races r WHERE r.year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2010 GROUP BY r.year ) races_per_year
SELECT nationality FROM formula_1.drivers GROUP BY nationality ORDER BY COUNT(driverid) DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY

WITH DriverTotalStats AS ( SELECT ds.driverid, SUM(ds.points) AS total_points, SUM(ds.wins) AS total_wins FROM formula_1.driverstandings ds GROUP BY ds.driverid ), RankedDrivers AS ( SELECT dts.total_wins, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY dts.total_points DESC) AS rnk FROM DriverTotalStats dts ) SELECT total_wins FROM RankedDrivers WHERE rnk = 91

SELECT R.name FROM formula_1.races R JOIN formula_1.results RES ON R.raceid = RES.raceid WHERE TO_NUMBER(RES.fastestlapspeed) = ( SELECT MAX(TO_NUMBER(fastestlapspeed)) FROM formula_1.results WHERE fastestlapspeed IS NOT NULL AND fastestlapspeed != '' )
SELECT c.location || ', ' || c.country FROM formula_1.races r JOIN formula_1.circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid WHERE r."DATE" = (SELECT MAX("DATE") FROM formula_1.races)

SELECT T1.forename, T1.surname FROM formula_1.drivers T1 INNER JOIN formula_1.qualifying T2 ON T1.driverid = T2.driverid INNER JOIN formula_1.races T3 ON T2.raceid = T3.raceid INNER JOIN formula_1.circuits T4 ON T3.circuitid = T4.circuitid WHERE T3.year = 2008 AND T4.name = 'Marina Bay Street Circuit' AND T2.q3 IS NOT NULL ORDER BY T2.q3 ASC FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY

SELECT d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS full_name, d.nationality, r.name AS first_race_name FROM formula_1.drivers d JOIN formula_1.results res ON d.driverid = res.driverid JOIN formula_1.races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid WHERE d.driverid = ( SELECT driverid FROM formula_1.drivers ORDER BY dob DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY ) ORDER BY r."DATE" ASC, r.raceid ASC FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY

WITH CanadianGPAccidents AS ( SELECT r.driverid, COUNT(r.resultid) AS accident_count FROM formula_1.results r JOIN formula_1.races ra ON r.raceid = ra.raceid WHERE ra.name = 'Canadian Grand Prix' AND r.statusid = 3 GROUP BY r.driverid ) SELECT MAX(accident_count) FROM CanadianGPAccidents

SELECT d.forename, d.surname, SUM(ds.wins) FROM formula_1.drivers d JOIN formula_1.driverstandings ds ON d.driverid = ds.driverid WHERE d.dob = ( SELECT MIN(dob) FROM formula_1.drivers ) GROUP BY d.forename, d.surname
SELECT duration FROM formula_1.pitstops WHERE milliseconds = ( SELECT MAX(milliseconds) FROM formula_1.pitstops )
SELECT MIN(milliseconds) FROM formula_1.laptimes
SELECT MAX(T1.milliseconds) FROM formula_1.pitstops T1 WHERE T1.driverid = 1
SELECT T1.lap FROM formula_1.pitstops T1 INNER JOIN formula_1.races T2 ON T1.raceid = T2.raceid WHERE T2.year = 2011 AND T2.name = 'Australian Grand Prix' AND T1.driverid = 1

SELECT d.forename, d.surname, SUM(TO_NUMBER(p.duration)) AS total_pit_stop_duration_seconds FROM formula_1.races r JOIN formula_1.pitstops p ON r.raceid = p.raceid JOIN formula_1.drivers d ON p.driverid = d.driverid WHERE r.year = 2011 AND r.name = 'Australian Grand Prix' GROUP BY d.forename, d.surname
SELECT MIN(T1.milliseconds) FROM formula_1.laptimes T1 INNER JOIN formula_1.drivers T2 ON T1.driverid = T2.driverid WHERE T2.forename = 'Lewis' AND T2.surname = 'Hamilton'

WITH DriverMinLap AS ( SELECT lt.driverid, MIN(lt.milliseconds) AS shortest_lap_ms FROM formula_1.laptimes lt GROUP BY lt.driverid ), RankedDrivers AS ( SELECT dml.driverid, dml.shortest_lap_ms, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY dml.shortest_lap_ms ASC) as rn FROM DriverMinLap dml ) SELECT d.forename, d.surname FROM RankedDrivers rd JOIN formula_1.drivers d ON rd.driverid = d.driverid WHERE rd.rn <= 20 ORDER BY rd.shortest_lap_ms ASC

SELECT T3.name AS circuit_name, T1.position AS driver_position_on_fastest_lap FROM formula_1.laptimes T1 INNER JOIN formula_1.races T2 ON T1.raceid = T2.raceid INNER JOIN formula_1.circuits T3 ON T2.circuitid = T3.circuitid INNER JOIN formula_1.drivers T4 ON T1.driverid = T4.driverid WHERE T4.forename = 'Lewis' AND T4.surname = 'Hamilton' AND T1.milliseconds = ( SELECT MIN(T5.milliseconds) FROM formula_1.laptimes T5 WHERE T5.raceid = T1.raceid AND T5.driverid = T1.driverid )
SELECT MIN(T1.milliseconds) FROM formula_1.laptimes T1 INNER JOIN formula_1.races T2 ON T1.raceid = T2.raceid WHERE T2.name = 'Austrian Grand Prix'

SELECT c.name, MIN(lt.milliseconds) FROM formula_1.circuits c JOIN formula_1.races r ON c.circuitid = r.circuitid JOIN formula_1.laptimes lt ON r.raceid = lt.raceid WHERE c.country = 'Italy' GROUP BY c.name

WITH AustrianGP_Circuits AS ( SELECT DISTINCT c.circuitid FROM formula_1.races r JOIN formula_1.circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid WHERE r.name LIKE '%Austrian Grand Prix%' ), FastestLap_Overall AS ( SELECT lt.raceid, lt.milliseconds AS fastest_lap_ms FROM formula_1.laptimes lt JOIN formula_1.races r ON lt.raceid = r.raceid WHERE r.circuitid IN (SELECT circuitid FROM AustrianGP_Circuits) ORDER BY lt.milliseconds ASC FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY ) SELECT r.name FROM formula_1.races r JOIN FastestLap_Overall flo ON r.raceid = flo.raceid

WITH AustrianGP_Circuits AS ( SELECT DISTINCT r.circuitid FROM formula_1.races r WHERE r.name = 'Austrian Grand Prix' ), AllLapsAtAustrianGP AS ( SELECT lt.raceid, lt.driverid, lt.milliseconds AS lap_milliseconds FROM formula_1.laptimes lt JOIN formula_1.races r ON lt.raceid = r.raceid WHERE r.circuitid IN (SELECT circuitid FROM AustrianGP_Circuits) ), FastestLapRecord AS ( SELECT raceid, driverid FROM AllLapsAtAustrianGP ORDER BY lap_milliseconds ASC FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY ) SELECT SUM(ps.milliseconds) FROM formula_1.pitstops ps JOIN FastestLapRecord flr ON ps.raceid = flr.raceid AND ps.driverid = flr.driverid

WITH FastestLapMillis AS ( SELECT r.circuitid, CASE WHEN INSTR(res.fastestlaptime, ':') > 0 THEN TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(res.fastestlaptime, 1, INSTR(res.fastestlaptime, ':') - 1)) * 60000 + TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(res.fastestlaptime, INSTR(res.fastestlaptime, ':') + 1, INSTR(res.fastestlaptime, '.') - INSTR(res.fastestlaptime, ':') - 1)) * 1000 + TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(res.fastestlaptime, INSTR(res.fastestlaptime, '.') + 1)) WHEN INSTR(res.fastestlaptime, ':') = 0 AND INSTR(res.fastestlaptime, '.') > 0 THEN TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(res.fastestlaptime, 1, INSTR(res.fastestlaptime, '.') - 1)) * 1000 + TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(res.fastestlaptime, INSTR(res.fastestlaptime, '.') + 1)) ELSE NULL END AS fastest_lap_milliseconds FROM formula_1.results res JOIN formula_1.races r ON res.raceid = r.raceid WHERE res.fastestlaptime IS NOT NULL AND INSTR(res.fastestlaptime, '.') > 0 ), CircuitRecords AS ( SELECT circuitid, MIN(fastest_lap_milliseconds) AS min_circuit_fastest_lap_millis FROM FastestLapMillis WHERE fastest_lap_milliseconds IS NOT NULL GROUP BY circuitid ) SELECT DISTINCT c.lat, c.lng FROM formula_1.circuits c JOIN CircuitRecords cr ON c.circuitid = cr.circuitid WHERE cr.min_circuit_fastest_lap_millis = 89488
SELECT AVG(milliseconds) FROM formula_1.pitstops WHERE driverid = 1

SELECT AVG(T3.milliseconds) FROM formula_1.circuits T1 INNER JOIN formula_1.races T2 ON T1.circuitid = T2.circuitid INNER JOIN formula_1.laptimes T3 ON T2.raceid = T3.raceid WHERE T1.country = 'Italy'
SELECT player_api_id FROM european_football_2.player_attributes ORDER BY overall_rating DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY
SELECT player_name FROM european_football_2.player ORDER BY height DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY
SELECT T1.preferred_foot FROM european_football_2.player_attributes T1 WHERE T1.potential = ( SELECT MIN(T2.potential) FROM european_football_2.player_attributes T2 )
SELECT COUNT(T1.player_api_id) FROM european_football_2.player_attributes T1 WHERE T1.overall_rating >= 60 AND T1.overall_rating < 65 AND T1.defensive_work_rate = 'low'
SELECT player_api_id FROM european_football_2.player_attributes ORDER BY crossing DESC FETCH FIRST 5 ROWS ONLY

SELECT l.name FROM european_football_2.match m JOIN european_football_2.league l ON m.league_id = l.id WHERE m.season = '2015/2016' GROUP BY l.name ORDER BY SUM(m.home_team_goal + m.away_team_goal) DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY

SELECT T.team_long_name FROM european_football_2.match M JOIN european_football_2.team T ON M.home_team_api_id = T.team_api_id WHERE M.season = '2015/2016' AND M.home_team_goal < M.away_team_goal GROUP BY T.team_long_name ORDER BY COUNT(M.home_team_api_id) ASC FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY

SELECT p.player_name FROM european_football_2.player p JOIN european_football_2.player_attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id GROUP BY p.player_name ORDER BY MAX(pa.penalties) DESC FETCH FIRST 10 ROWS ONLY

SELECT T2.team_long_name FROM european_football_2.match T1 INNER JOIN european_football_2.team T2 ON T1.away_team_api_id = T2.team_api_id INNER JOIN european_football_2.league T3 ON T1.league_id = T3.id WHERE T3.name = 'Scotland Premier League' AND T1.season = '2009/2010' AND T1.away_team_goal > T1.home_team_goal GROUP BY T2.team_long_name ORDER BY COUNT(T1.id) DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY

SELECT T.team_long_name, TA.buildupplayspeed FROM european_football_2.team T JOIN european_football_2.team_attributes TA ON T.team_api_id = TA.team_api_id ORDER BY TA.buildupplayspeed DESC FETCH FIRST 4 ROWS ONLY

WITH FilteredTeamAttributes AS ( SELECT ta.team_api_id, ta.chancecreationpassing FROM european_football_2.team_attributes ta WHERE ta.buildupplaydribblingclass = 'Normal' AND ta."DATE" >= '2014-01-01 00:00:00' AND ta."DATE" <= '2014-01-31 00:00:00' ), AverageChanceCreationPassing AS ( SELECT AVG(chancecreationpassing) AS avg_passing FROM FilteredTeamAttributes ) SELECT t.team_long_name FROM european_football_2.team t JOIN FilteredTeamAttributes fta ON t.team_api_id = fta.team_api_id CROSS JOIN AverageChanceCreationPassing acp WHERE fta.chancecreationpassing < acp.avg_passing ORDER BY fta.chancecreationpassing DESC

WITH PlayerRatings AS ( SELECT p.player_name, pa.overall_rating, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.player_api_id ORDER BY pa."DATE" DESC) AS rn FROM european_football_2.player p JOIN european_football_2.player_attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id WHERE p.player_name IN ('Ariel Borysiuk', 'Paulin Puel') ), LatestPlayerRatings AS ( SELECT player_name, overall_rating FROM PlayerRatings WHERE rn = 1 ) SELECT (MAX(CASE WHEN player_name = 'Ariel Borysiuk' THEN overall_rating END) - MAX(CASE WHEN player_name = 'Paulin Puel' THEN overall_rating END)) / MAX(CASE WHEN player_name = 'Paulin Puel' THEN overall_rating END) * 100 FROM LatestPlayerRatings

WITH LatestPlayerJumping AS ( SELECT p.id AS player_id, pa.jumping, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.id ORDER BY TO_DATE(pa."DATE", 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') DESC) as rn FROM european_football_2.player p JOIN european_football_2.player_attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id WHERE p.id IN (6, 23) ) SELECT (SELECT jumping FROM LatestPlayerJumping WHERE player_id = 6 AND rn = 1) - (SELECT jumping FROM LatestPlayerJumping WHERE player_id = 23 AND rn = 1) AS jumping_score_difference FROM dual

WITH MaxWeightPlayer AS ( SELECT player_api_id FROM european_football_2.player WHERE weight = ( SELECT MAX(weight) FROM european_football_2.player ) ), PlayerLatestAttributes AS ( SELECT pa.player_api_id, pa.finishing, pa.curve, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY pa.player_api_id ORDER BY TO_DATE(pa."DATE", 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') DESC) AS rn FROM european_football_2.player_attributes pa JOIN MaxWeightPlayer mwp ON pa.player_api_id = mwp.player_api_id ) SELECT pla.finishing, pla.curve FROM PlayerLatestAttributes pla WHERE pla.rn = 1
SELECT l.name FROM european_football_2.match m JOIN european_football_2.league l ON m.league_id = l.id WHERE m.season = '2015/2016' GROUP BY l.name ORDER BY COUNT(m.id) DESC FETCH FIRST 4 ROWS ONLY

SELECT p.player_name FROM european_football_2.player_attributes pa JOIN european_football_2.player p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id ORDER BY pa.overall_rating DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY

WITH LatestPlayerAttributes AS ( SELECT player_api_id, overall_rating, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY player_api_id ORDER BY TO_DATE("DATE", 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') DESC) as rn FROM european_football_2.player_attributes ) SELECT (COUNT(CASE WHEN p.height < 180 AND lpa.overall_rating > 70 THEN 1 END) * 100.0) / COUNT(DISTINCT p.player_api_id) FROM european_football_2.player p JOIN LatestPlayerAttributes lpa ON p.player_api_id = lpa.player_api_id WHERE lpa.rn = 1

WITH MaleAdmissionCounts AS ( SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN p.admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS in_patient_males_count, SUM(CASE WHEN p.admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS out_patient_males_count FROM thrombosis_prediction.patient p WHERE p.sex = 'M' ) SELECT CASE WHEN mac.in_patient_males_count > mac.out_patient_males_count THEN 'in-patient' WHEN mac.out_patient_males_count > mac.in_patient_males_count THEN 'outpatient' ELSE 'equal' END AS comparison_result, CASE WHEN mac.out_patient_males_count = 0 THEN NULL ELSE ( (CAST(mac.in_patient_males_count AS NUMBER) / mac.out_patient_males_count) - 1 ) * 100 END AS percentage_deviation FROM MaleAdmissionCounts mac
SELECT (COUNT(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM p.birthday) > 1930 THEN p.id END) * 100.0) / COUNT(p.id) FROM thrombosis_prediction.patient p WHERE p.sex = 'F'

SELECT ( SUM( CASE WHEN T1.admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) * 100.0 ) / COUNT(T1.id) FROM thrombosis_prediction.patient T1 WHERE T1.birthday BETWEEN TO_DATE('1930-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND TO_DATE('1940-12-31', 'YYYY-MM-DD')
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN T1.admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / SUM(CASE WHEN T1.admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM thrombosis_prediction.patient T1 WHERE T1.diagnosis = 'SLE'
SELECT p.diagnosis, l."DATE" FROM thrombosis_prediction.patient p JOIN thrombosis_prediction.laboratory l ON p.id = l.id WHERE p.id = 30609
SELECT p.sex, p.birthday, e."EXAMINATION DATE", e.symptoms FROM thrombosis_prediction.patient p JOIN thrombosis_prediction.examination e ON p.id = e.id WHERE p.id = 163109
SELECT DISTINCT p.id, p.sex, p.birthday FROM thrombosis_prediction.patient p JOIN thrombosis_prediction.laboratory l ON p.id = l.id WHERE l.ldh > 500
SELECT p.id, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM SYSDATE) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM p.birthday) FROM thrombosis_prediction.patient p JOIN thrombosis_prediction.examination e ON p.id = e.id WHERE e.rvvt = '+'
SELECT T1.id, T1.sex, T1.diagnosis FROM thrombosis_prediction.patient T1 INNER JOIN thrombosis_prediction.examination T2 ON T1.id = T2.id WHERE T2.thrombosis = 2
SELECT DISTINCT p.id FROM thrombosis_prediction.patient p JOIN thrombosis_prediction.laboratory l ON p.id = l.id WHERE TO_CHAR(p.birthday, 'YYYY') = '1937' AND l."T-CHO" >= 250
SELECT p.id, p.sex, p.diagnosis FROM thrombosis_prediction.patient p JOIN thrombosis_prediction.laboratory l ON p.id = l.id WHERE l.alb < 3.5

SELECT (COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN l.tp <= 6.0 OR l.tp >= 8.5 THEN p.id END) * 100.0) / COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) FROM thrombosis_prediction.patient p JOIN thrombosis_prediction.laboratory l ON p.id = l.id WHERE p.sex = 'F'

SELECT AVG(T2."ACL IGG") FROM thrombosis_prediction.patient T1 INNER JOIN thrombosis_prediction.examination T2 ON T1.id = T2.id WHERE T1.admission = '+' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM SYSDATE) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM T1.birthday) >= 50
SELECT COUNT(id) FROM thrombosis_prediction.patient WHERE sex = 'F' AND TO_CHAR(description, 'YYYY') = '1997' AND admission = '-'
SELECT MIN(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM p."FIRST DATE") - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM p.birthday)) FROM thrombosis_prediction.patient p

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.id) FROM thrombosis_prediction.examination T1 INNER JOIN thrombosis_prediction.patient T2 ON T1.id = T2.id WHERE T1.thrombosis = 1 AND TO_CHAR(T1."EXAMINATION DATE", 'YYYY') = '1997' AND T2.sex = 'F'
SELECT MAX(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM p.birthday)) - MIN(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM p.birthday)) FROM thrombosis_prediction.patient p JOIN thrombosis_prediction.laboratory l ON p.id = l.id WHERE l.tg >= 200

SELECT e.symptoms, e.diagnosis FROM thrombosis_prediction.examination e JOIN thrombosis_prediction.patient p ON e.id = p.id WHERE p.birthday = ( SELECT MAX(birthday) FROM thrombosis_prediction.patient ) AND e.symptoms IS NOT NULL

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.id) / 12 FROM thrombosis_prediction.patient T1 INNER JOIN thrombosis_prediction.laboratory T2 ON T1.id = T2.id WHERE T1.sex = 'M' AND T2."DATE" BETWEEN TO_DATE('1998-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND TO_DATE('1998-12-31', 'YYYY-MM-DD')

WITH OldestSJS AS ( SELECT p.id, p.birthday, p."FIRST DATE" FROM thrombosis_prediction.patient p WHERE p.diagnosis = 'SJS' ORDER BY p.birthday ASC FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY ) SELECT (SELECT MAX(l."DATE") FROM thrombosis_prediction.laboratory l WHERE l.id = os.id) AS laboratory_completion_date, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM os."FIRST DATE") - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM os.birthday) AS age_at_first_arrival FROM OldestSJS os

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.sex = 'M' AND l.ua <= 8.0 THEN p.id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.sex = 'F' AND l.ua <= 6.5 THEN p.id END), 0) FROM thrombosis_prediction.patient p JOIN thrombosis_prediction.laboratory l ON p.id = l.id

SELECT COUNT(pfv.patient_id) FROM ( SELECT p.id AS patient_id, p."FIRST DATE" AS first_visit_date FROM thrombosis_prediction.patient p ) pfv LEFT JOIN ( SELECT e.id AS patient_id, MIN(e."EXAMINATION DATE") AS first_examination_date FROM thrombosis_prediction.examination e GROUP BY e.id ) pfe ON pfv.patient_id = pfe.patient_id WHERE pfe.first_examination_date IS NULL OR pfe.first_examination_date > ADD_MONTHS(pfv.first_visit_date, 12)

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) FROM thrombosis_prediction.examination e JOIN thrombosis_prediction.patient p ON e.id = p.id WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM e."EXAMINATION DATE") BETWEEN 1990 AND 1993 AND TRUNC(MONTHS_BETWEEN(e."EXAMINATION DATE", p.birthday) / 12) < 18

WITH CleanedLabData AS ( SELECT id, -- Safely convert U-PRO to a number. -- The CASE statement ensures TO_NUMBER is only called on strings that match the numeric pattern. -- If U-PRO is NULL, empty, or not a valid positive number string, U_PRO_NUM will be NULL. CASE WHEN "U-PRO" IS NOT NULL AND TRIM("U-PRO") IS NOT NULL AND REGEXP_LIKE(TRIM("U-PRO"), '^\d+(\.\d+)?$') THEN TO_NUMBER(TRIM("U-PRO")) ELSE NULL END AS U_PRO_NUM, UA FROM thrombosis_prediction.laboratory ), PatientsWithNormalUPro AS ( -- Select distinct patient IDs who have at least one U-PRO reading within the normal range SELECT DISTINCT id FROM CleanedLabData WHERE U_PRO_NUM > 0 AND U_PRO_NUM < 30 ), PatientsWithLowUa AS ( -- Select distinct patient IDs who have at least one UA reading below the normal range SELECT DISTINCT id FROM thrombosis_prediction.laboratory WHERE UA <= 6.5 ) SELECT CASE -- Handle the case where there are no patients with normal U-PRO to avoid division by zero WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PatientsWithNormalUPro) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ( -- Calculate the count of patients who meet both conditions CAST( (SELECT COUNT(pnu.id) FROM PatientsWithNormalUPro pnu JOIN PatientsWithLowUa plu ON pnu.id = plu.id) AS NUMBER ) / -- Divide by the total count of patients with normal U-PRO (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PatientsWithNormalUPro) ) * 100 END AS percentage_of_patients FROM DUAL

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.id) FROM thrombosis_prediction.laboratory T1 INNER JOIN thrombosis_prediction.examination T2 ON T1.id = T2.id WHERE T2.thrombosis = 0 AND ( CASE -- Case 1: RF is a purely numeric string (e.g., '15', '25.5') WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(TRIM(T1.rf), '^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$') THEN CASE WHEN TO_NUMBER(TRIM(T1.rf)) < 20 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END -- Case 2: RF is a string like '<X' (e.g., '<10', '<40') WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(TRIM(T1.rf), '^<[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$') THEN -- For '<X' to be considered 'normal RF' (i.e., RF < 20), -- the value X itself must be less than or equal to 20. -- If X > 20 (e.g., '<40'), it only means RF < 40, which does not guarantee RF < 20. CASE WHEN TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(TRIM(T1.rf), 2)) <= 20 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END -- Case 3: Any other format (e.g., '-', '+-', 'N/A', NULL, or invalid '<' format) ELSE 0 -- Not considered normal RF END = 1 )

WITH CustomerAnnualConsumption AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ym.customerid, ym.consumption AS annual_consumption FROM debit_card_specializing.yearmonth ym WHERE SUBSTR(ym."DATE", 1, 4) = '2013' ) SELECT AVG(cac.annual_consumption) / 12 FROM CustomerAnnualConsumption cac JOIN debit_card_specializing.customers c ON cac.customerid = c.customerid WHERE c.segment = 'SME'

WITH CustomerGasConsumption AS ( SELECT c.customerid, SUM(t.amount * t.price) AS total_gas_consumption FROM debit_card_specializing.customers c JOIN debit_card_specializing.transactions_1k t ON c.customerid = t.customerid JOIN debit_card_specializing.products p ON t.productid = p.productid WHERE c.currency = 'CZK' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM t."DATE") = 2011 AND UPPER(p.description) LIKE '%GAS%' GROUP BY c.customerid ) SELECT customerid FROM CustomerGasConsumption WHERE total_gas_consumption = (SELECT MAX(total_gas_consumption) FROM CustomerGasConsumption)

WITH YearlyConsumption AS ( SELECT ym.customerid, c.currency, ym.consumption FROM debit_card_specializing.yearmonth ym JOIN debit_card_specializing.customers c ON ym.customerid = c.customerid WHERE SUBSTR(ym."DATE", 1, 4) = '2012' ), CZK_Consumption AS ( SELECT SUM(consumption) AS total_czk_consumption FROM YearlyConsumption WHERE currency = 'CZK' ), EUR_Consumption AS ( SELECT SUM(consumption) AS total_eur_consumption FROM YearlyConsumption WHERE currency = 'EUR' ) SELECT ( SELECT total_czk_consumption FROM CZK_Consumption ) - ( SELECT total_eur_consumption FROM EUR_Consumption ) FROM DUAL

SELECT TO_CHAR(t."DATE", 'YYYY') FROM debit_card_specializing.transactions_1k t JOIN debit_card_specializing.products p ON t.productid = p.productid JOIN debit_card_specializing.customers c ON t.customerid = c.customerid WHERE LOWER(p.description) LIKE '%gas%' AND c.currency = 'EUR' GROUP BY TO_CHAR(t."DATE", 'YYYY') ORDER BY SUM(t.amount) DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY
