WITH MonthlyConsumption AS ( SELECT SUBSTR(ym."DATE", 5, 2) AS month_num, SUM(ym.consumption) AS total_consumption FROM debit_card_specializing.yearmonth ym JOIN debit_card_specializing.customers c ON ym.customerid = c.customerid WHERE SUBSTR(ym."DATE", 1, 4) = '2013' AND c.segment = 'SME' GROUP BY SUBSTR(ym."DATE", 5, 2) ) SELECT month_num FROM MonthlyConsumption ORDER BY total_consumption DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY

WITH filtered_customers_2013 AS ( SELECT ym.customerid, c.segment, ym.consumption FROM debit_card_specializing.yearmonth ym JOIN debit_card_specializing.customers c ON ym.customerid = c.customerid WHERE c.currency = 'CZK' AND SUBSTR(ym."DATE", 1, 4) = '2013' ), customer_total_consumption AS ( SELECT customerid, segment, SUM(consumption) AS total_consumption_2013 FROM filtered_customers_2013 GROUP BY customerid, segment ), min_consumption_per_segment AS ( SELECT segment, MIN(total_consumption_2013) AS min_segment_consumption FROM customer_total_consumption GROUP BY segment ), least_consumption_customers_data AS ( SELECT ctc.customerid, ctc.segment, ctc.total_consumption_2013 FROM customer_total_consumption ctc JOIN min_consumption_per_segment mcps ON ctc.segment = mcps.segment WHERE ctc.total_consumption_2013 = mcps.min_segment_consumption ), segment_annual_average AS ( SELECT segment, SUM(total_consumption_2013) / COUNT(DISTINCT customerid) AS annual_avg_consumption FROM least_consumption_customers_data GROUP BY segment ) SELECT (SELECT annual_avg_consumption FROM segment_annual_average WHERE segment = 'SME') - (SELECT annual_avg_consumption FROM segment_annual_average WHERE segment = 'LAM') AS sme_lam_difference, (SELECT annual_avg_consumption FROM segment_annual_average WHERE segment = 'LAM') - (SELECT annual_avg_consumption FROM segment_annual_average WHERE segment = 'KAM') AS lam_kam_difference, (SELECT annual_avg_consumption FROM segment_annual_average WHERE segment = 'KAM') - (SELECT annual_avg_consumption FROM segment_annual_average WHERE segment = 'SME') AS kam_sme_difference FROM dual

WITH SegmentConsumption AS ( SELECT c.segment, SUBSTR(ym."DATE", 1, 4) AS year, SUM(ym.consumption) AS total_consumption FROM debit_card_specializing.yearmonth ym JOIN debit_card_specializing.customers c ON ym.customerid = c.customerid WHERE c.currency = 'EUR' AND SUBSTR(ym."DATE", 1, 4) IN ('2012', '2013') AND c.segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM') GROUP BY c.segment, SUBSTR(ym."DATE", 1, 4) ), SegmentYearlyConsumption AS ( SELECT segment, SUM(CASE WHEN year = '2012' THEN total_consumption ELSE 0 END) AS consumption_2012, SUM(CASE WHEN year = '2013' THEN total_consumption ELSE 0 END) AS consumption_2013 FROM SegmentConsumption GROUP BY segment ), SegmentPercentageIncrease AS ( SELECT segment, CASE WHEN consumption_2013 = 0 THEN NULL -- Avoid division by zero; percentage is undefined ELSE (consumption_2013 - consumption_2012) / consumption_2013 * 100 END AS percentage_increase FROM SegmentYearlyConsumption ) SELECT segment FROM SegmentPercentageIncrease WHERE percentage_increase = (SELECT MAX(percentage_increase) FROM SegmentPercentageIncrease) OR percentage_increase = (SELECT MIN(percentage_increase) FROM SegmentPercentageIncrease) ORDER BY percentage_increase DESC

SELECT (COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ym.consumption > 46.73 THEN c.customerid END) * 100.0) / COUNT(DISTINCT c.customerid) FROM debit_card_specializing.customers c JOIN debit_card_specializing.yearmonth ym ON c.customerid = ym.customerid WHERE c.segment = 'LAM'

WITH StationAvgPrices AS ( SELECT t.gasstationid, AVG(t.price) AS avg_station_price FROM debit_card_specializing.transactions_1k t GROUP BY t.gasstationid ), OverallAvgPrice AS ( SELECT AVG(t.price) AS overall_avg_price FROM debit_card_specializing.transactions_1k t ) SELECT gs.country, COUNT(sap.gasstationid) AS value_for_money_gasstations_count FROM StationAvgPrices sap JOIN OverallAvgPrice oap ON 1=1 JOIN debit_card_specializing.gasstations gs ON sap.gasstationid = gs.gasstationid WHERE sap.avg_station_price < oap.overall_avg_price GROUP BY gs.country ORDER BY value_for_money_gasstations_count DESC
SELECT ( SUM(CASE WHEN c.currency = 'Euro' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(c.customerid) ) * 100 FROM debit_card_specializing.customers c WHERE c.segment = 'KAM'
SELECT (COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ym.consumption > 528.3 THEN ym.customerid END) * 100.0) / COUNT(DISTINCT ym.customerid) FROM debit_card_specializing.yearmonth ym WHERE ym."DATE" = '201202'
SELECT ( SUM(CASE WHEN T1.segment = 'Premium' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(T1.gasstationid) ) * 100 FROM debit_card_specializing.gasstations T1 WHERE T1.country = 'Slovakia'
SELECT customerid FROM debit_card_specializing.yearmonth WHERE "DATE" = '201309' ORDER BY consumption DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY

SELECT c.segment FROM debit_card_specializing.yearmonth ym JOIN debit_card_specializing.customers c ON ym.customerid = c.customerid WHERE ym."DATE" = '201309' GROUP BY c.segment ORDER BY SUM(ym.consumption) ASC FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY

SELECT ym.customerid FROM debit_card_specializing.yearmonth ym JOIN debit_card_specializing.customers c ON ym.customerid = c.customerid WHERE ym."DATE" = '201206' AND c.segment = 'SME' ORDER BY ym.consumption ASC FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY
SELECT MAX(T1.consumption) FROM debit_card_specializing.yearmonth T1 WHERE SUBSTR(T1."DATE", 1, 4) = '2012'
SELECT MAX(ym.consumption / 12) FROM debit_card_specializing.yearmonth ym JOIN debit_card_specializing.customers c ON ym.customerid = c.customerid WHERE c.currency = 'EUR'

SELECT T1.description FROM debit_card_specializing.products T1 INNER JOIN debit_card_specializing.transactions_1k T2 ON T1.productid = T2.productid WHERE TO_CHAR(T2."DATE", 'YYYYMM') = '201309' GROUP BY T1.description

SELECT DISTINCT T2.country FROM debit_card_specializing.transactions_1k T1 INNER JOIN debit_card_specializing.gasstations T2 ON T1.gasstationid = T2.gasstationid WHERE TO_CHAR(T1."DATE", 'YYYYMM') = '201306'

SELECT DISTINCT t1.chainid FROM debit_card_specializing.gasstations t1 INNER JOIN debit_card_specializing.transactions_1k t2 ON t1.gasstationid = t2.gasstationid INNER JOIN debit_card_specializing.customers t3 ON t2.customerid = t3.customerid WHERE t3.currency = 'EUR'

SELECT DISTINCT p.description FROM debit_card_specializing.products p JOIN debit_card_specializing.transactions_1k t ON p.productid = t.productid JOIN debit_card_specializing.customers c ON t.customerid = c.customerid WHERE c.currency = 'EUR'
SELECT AVG(t.amount * t.price) FROM debit_card_specializing.transactions_1k t WHERE TO_CHAR(t."DATE", 'YYYY-MM') = '2012-01'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.customerid) FROM debit_card_specializing.customers T1 INNER JOIN debit_card_specializing.yearmonth T2 ON T1.customerid = T2.customerid WHERE T1.currency = 'EUR' AND T2.consumption > 1000

SELECT DISTINCT T3.description FROM debit_card_specializing.transactions_1k T1 INNER JOIN debit_card_specializing.gasstations T2 ON T1.gasstationid = T2.gasstationid INNER JOIN debit_card_specializing.products T3 ON T1.productid = T3.productid WHERE T2.country = 'CZE'
SELECT DISTINCT T1.time FROM debit_card_specializing.transactions_1k T1 INNER JOIN debit_card_specializing.gasstations T2 ON T1.gasstationid = T2.gasstationid WHERE T2.chainid = 11

SELECT COUNT(T1.transactionid) FROM debit_card_specializing.transactions_1k T1 INNER JOIN debit_card_specializing.gasstations T2 ON T1.gasstationid = T2.gasstationid WHERE T2.country = 'CZE' AND T1.price > 1000

SELECT COUNT(T.transactionid) FROM debit_card_specializing.transactions_1k T JOIN debit_card_specializing.gasstations G ON T.gasstationid = G.gasstationid WHERE G.country = 'CZE' AND T."DATE" > TO_DATE('2012-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD')
SELECT AVG(t.amount * t.price) FROM debit_card_specializing.transactions_1k t JOIN debit_card_specializing.gasstations g ON t.gasstationid = g.gasstationid WHERE g.country = 'CZE'
SELECT AVG(t.amount * t.price) FROM debit_card_specializing.transactions_1k t JOIN debit_card_specializing.customers c ON t.customerid = c.customerid WHERE c.currency = 'EUR'

SELECT t.customerid FROM debit_card_specializing.transactions_1k t WHERE t."DATE" = TO_DATE('2012-08-25', 'YYYY-MM-DD') GROUP BY t.customerid ORDER BY SUM(t.amount * t.price) DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY

SELECT gs.country FROM debit_card_specializing.transactions_1k t JOIN debit_card_specializing.gasstations gs ON t.gasstationid = gs.gasstationid WHERE t."DATE" = TO_DATE('2012-08-25', 'YYYY-MM-DD') ORDER BY t.time FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY

SELECT T2.currency FROM debit_card_specializing.transactions_1k T1 INNER JOIN debit_card_specializing.customers T2 ON T1.customerid = T2.customerid WHERE T1."DATE" = TO_DATE('2012-08-24', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND T1.time = '16:25:00'

SELECT T2.segment FROM debit_card_specializing.transactions_1k T1 INNER JOIN debit_card_specializing.customers T2 ON T1.customerid = T2.customerid WHERE T1."DATE" = TO_DATE('2012-08-23', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND T1.time = '21:20:00'

SELECT COUNT(T1.transactionid) FROM debit_card_specializing.transactions_1k T1 INNER JOIN debit_card_specializing.customers T2 ON T1.customerid = T2.customerid WHERE T1."DATE" = TO_DATE('2012-08-26', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND T1.time < '13:00:00' AND T2.currency = 'CZK'
SELECT segment FROM debit_card_specializing.customers ORDER BY customerid FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY

SELECT T2.country FROM debit_card_specializing.transactions_1k T1 INNER JOIN debit_card_specializing.gasstations T2 ON T1.gasstationid = T2.gasstationid WHERE T1."DATE" = TO_DATE('2012-08-24', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND T1.time = '12:42:00'
SELECT T1.productid FROM debit_card_specializing.transactions_1k T1 WHERE T1."DATE" = TO_DATE('2012-08-23', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND T1.time = '21:20:00'

WITH TargetCustomer AS ( SELECT DISTINCT customerid FROM debit_card_specializing.transactions_1k WHERE "DATE" = TO_DATE('2012-08-24', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND amount * price = 124.05 ) SELECT t."DATE", t.amount * t.price AS expense, SUM(t.amount * t.price) OVER () AS total_jan_2012_spending FROM debit_card_specializing.transactions_1k t JOIN TargetCustomer tc ON t.customerid = tc.customerid WHERE t."DATE" >= TO_DATE('2012-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND t."DATE" < TO_DATE('2012-02-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') -- More robust way to filter for January ORDER BY t."DATE"

SELECT COUNT(T1.transactionid) FROM debit_card_specializing.transactions_1k T1 INNER JOIN debit_card_specializing.gasstations T2 ON T1.gasstationid = T2.gasstationid WHERE T2.country = 'CZE' AND T1."DATE" = TO_DATE('2012-08-26', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND T1.time BETWEEN '08:00:00' AND '09:00:00'
SELECT T2.currency FROM debit_card_specializing.yearmonth T1 INNER JOIN debit_card_specializing.customers T2 ON T1.customerid = T2.customerid WHERE T1."DATE" = '201306' AND T1.consumption = 214582.17
SELECT DISTINCT T2.country FROM debit_card_specializing.transactions_1k T1 INNER JOIN debit_card_specializing.gasstations T2 ON T1.gasstationid = T2.gasstationid WHERE T1.cardid = 667467

SELECT DISTINCT T3.country FROM debit_card_specializing.yearmonth T1 JOIN debit_card_specializing.transactions_1k T2 ON T1.customerid = T2.customerid JOIN debit_card_specializing.gasstations T3 ON T2.gasstationid = T3.gasstationid WHERE T1."DATE" = '2012-08-24' AND T1.consumption = 548.4 AND T2."DATE" = TO_DATE('2012-08-24', 'YYYY-MM-DD')

SELECT ( COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.currency = 'EUR' THEN t.customerid END) * 100.0 ) / COUNT(DISTINCT t.customerid) FROM debit_card_specializing.transactions_1k t JOIN debit_card_specializing.customers c ON t.customerid = c.customerid WHERE t."DATE" = TO_DATE('2012-08-25', 'YYYY-MM-DD')

WITH CustomerID_Finder AS ( SELECT t.customerid FROM debit_card_specializing.transactions_1k t WHERE t.amount = 634.8 AND t."DATE" = TO_DATE('2012/08/25', 'YYYY/MM/DD') ), CustomerConsumption AS ( SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(ym."DATE", 1, 4) = '2012' THEN ym.consumption ELSE 0 END) AS consumption_2012, SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(ym."DATE", 1, 4) = '2013' THEN ym.consumption ELSE 0 END) AS consumption_2013 FROM debit_card_specializing.yearmonth ym WHERE ym.customerid = ( SELECT customerid FROM CustomerID_Finder ) ) SELECT (cc.consumption_2012 - cc.consumption_2013) / cc.consumption_2012 FROM CustomerConsumption cc
SELECT t.gasstationid FROM debit_card_specializing.transactions_1k t GROUP BY t.gasstationid ORDER BY SUM(t.amount * t.price) DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY

WITH CustomersInSVK AS ( SELECT DISTINCT t.customerid FROM debit_card_specializing.transactions_1k t JOIN debit_card_specializing.gasstations g ON t.gasstationid = g.gasstationid WHERE g.country = 'SVK' ), SegmentCounts AS ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT cis.customerid) AS total_customers_in_svk, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.segment = 'premium' THEN cis.customerid END) AS premium_customers_in_svk FROM CustomersInSVK cis JOIN debit_card_specializing.customers c ON cis.customerid = c.customerid ) SELECT (sc.premium_customers_in_svk * 100.0) / sc.total_customers_in_svk FROM SegmentCounts sc

SELECT SUM(t.amount * t.price) AS total_spent_by_customer_38508, SUM(CASE WHEN TO_CHAR(t."DATE", 'YYYYMM') = '201201' THEN t.amount * t.price ELSE 0 END) AS spent_in_jan_2012 FROM debit_card_specializing.transactions_1k t WHERE t.customerid = 38508

SELECT p.description FROM debit_card_specializing.transactions_1k t JOIN debit_card_specializing.products p ON t.productid = p.productid GROUP BY p.description ORDER BY SUM(t.amount) DESC FETCH FIRST 5 ROWS ONLY

WITH customer_spending AS ( SELECT t.customerid, SUM(t.price) AS total_spent, SUM(t.amount) AS total_amount_purchased FROM debit_card_specializing.transactions_1k t GROUP BY t.customerid ), ranked_customers AS ( SELECT cs.customerid, cs.total_spent, cs.total_amount_purchased, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cs.total_spent DESC) AS rn FROM customer_spending cs ) SELECT rc.customerid, CASE WHEN rc.total_amount_purchased > 0 THEN rc.total_spent / rc.total_amount_purchased ELSE 0 END AS average_price_per_single_item, c.currency FROM ranked_customers rc JOIN debit_card_specializing.customers c ON rc.customerid = c.customerid WHERE rc.rn = 1

SELECT gs.country FROM debit_card_specializing.transactions_1k t JOIN debit_card_specializing.gasstations gs ON t.gasstationid = gs.gasstationid WHERE t.productid = 2 ORDER BY t.price DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY

WITH HighPriceCustomers AS ( SELECT DISTINCT t.customerid FROM debit_card_specializing.transactions_1k t WHERE t.productid = 5 AND t.amount != 0 -- Added condition to prevent division by zero AND t.price / t.amount > 29.00 ) SELECT ym.consumption FROM debit_card_specializing.yearmonth ym JOIN HighPriceCustomers hpc ON ym.customerid = hpc.customerid WHERE ym."DATE" = '201208'
